sections.label: Glorification of the Prime Cause of all things
sections.name: Hymn 1

verses.sa:
वेनस्तत् पश्यत् परमं गुहा यद् यत्र विश्वं भवत्येकरूपम्।
इदं पृश्निरदुहज्जायमानाः स्वर्विदो अभ्यऽनूषत व्राः॥
verses.tr: venastat paśyat paramaṃ guhā yad yatra viśvaṃ bhavatyekarūpam idaṃ pṛśniraduhajjāyamānāḥ svarvido abhya'nūṣata vrāḥ
verses.en: Vena beholds That Highest which lies hidden, wherein this All resumes one form and fashion. Thence Prisni milked all life that had existence: the hosts that know the light with songs extolled her.

verses.sa:
प्र तद् वोचेदमृतस्य विद्वान् गन्धर्वो धाम परमं गुहा यत्।
त्रीणि पदानि निहिता गुहास्य यस्तानि वेद स पितुष्पितासत्॥
verses.tr: pra tad vocedamṛtasya vidvān gandharvo dhāma paramaṃ guhā yat trīṇi padāni nihitā guhāsya yastāni veda sa pituṣpitāsat
verses.en: Knowing Eternity, may the Gandharva declare to us that highest secret station. Three steps thereof lie hidden in the darkness: he who knows these shall be the father's father.

verses.sa:
स नः पिता जनिता स उत बन्धुर्धामानि वेद भुवनानि विश्वा ।
यो देवानां नामध एक एव तं संप्रश्नं भुवना यन्ति सर्वा॥
verses.tr: sa naḥ pitā janitā sa uta bandhurdhāmāni veda bhuvanāni viśvā yo devānāṃ nāmadha eka eva taṃ saṃpraśnaṃ bhuvanā yanti sarvā
verses.en: He is our kinsman, father, and begetter: he knows all beings and all Ordinances. He only gave the Gods their appellations: all creatures go to him to ask direction.

verses.sa:
परि द्यावापृथिवी सद्य आयमुपातिष्ठे प्रथमजामृतस्य ।
वाचमिव वक्तरि भुवनेष्ठा धास्युरेष नन्वे३षो अग्निः॥
verses.tr: pari dyāvāpṛthivī sadya āyamupātiṣṭhe prathamajāmṛtasya vācamiva vaktari bhuvaneṣṭhā dhāsyureṣa nanve3ṣo agniḥ
verses.en: I have gone forth around the earth and heaven, I have approached the first-born Son of Order. He, putting voice, as 'twere, within the speaker, stands in the world, he, verily is Agni.

verses.sa:
परि विश्वा भुवनान्यायमृतस्य तन्तुं विततं दृशे कम्।
यत्र देवा अमृतमानशानाः समाने योनावध्यैरयन्त॥
verses.tr: pari viśvā bhuvanānyāyamṛtasya tantuṃ vitataṃ dṛśe kam yatra devā amṛtamānaśānāḥ samāne yonāvadhyairayanta
verses.en: I round the circumjacent worlds have travelled to see the far-extended thread of Order, Wherein the Gods, obtaining life eternal, have risen; upward to one common birthplace.

sections.label: A charm to ensure success m gambling
sections.name: Hymn 2

verses.sa:
दिव्यो गन्धर्वो भुवनस्य यस्पतिरेक एव नमस्योऽविक्ष्वीड्यः ।
तं त्वा यौमि ब्रह्मणा दिव्य देव नमस्ते अस्तु दिवि ते सधस्थम्॥
verses.tr: divyo gandharvo bhuvanasya yaspatireka eva namasyo'vikṣvīḍyaḥ taṃ tvā yaumi brahmaṇā divya deva namaste astu divi te sadhastham
verses.en: Lord of the World, divine Gandharva, only he should be honoured in the Tribes and worshipped. Fast with my spell, celestial God, I hold thee. Homage to thee! Thy home is in the heavens.

verses.sa:
दिवि स्पृष्टो यजतः सूर्यत्वगवयाता हरसो दैव्यस्य ।
मृडाद् गन्धर्वो भुवनस्य यस्पतिरेक एव नमस्यः सुशेवाः॥
verses.tr: divi spṛṣṭo yajataḥ sūryatvagavayātā haraso daivyasya mṛḍād gandharvo bhuvanasya yaspatireka eva namasyaḥ suśevāḥ
verses.en: Sky-reaching, like the Sun in brightness, holy, he who averts from us the Gods' displeasure, Lord of the World, may the Gandharva bless us, the friendly God who only must be worshipped.

verses.sa:
अनवद्याभिः समु जग्म आभिरप्सरास्वपि गन्धर्व आसीत्।
समुद्र आसां सदनं म आहुर्यतः सद्य आ च परा च यन्ति॥
verses.tr: anavadyābhiḥ samu jagma ābhirapsarāsvapi gandharva āsīt samudra āsāṃ sadanaṃ ma āhuryataḥ sadya ā ca parā ca yanti
verses.en: I came, I met these faultless, blameless beings: among the Apsarases was the Gandharva. Their home is in the sea—so men have told me,—whence they come quickly hitherward and vanish.

verses.sa:
अभ्रिये दिद्युन्नक्षत्रिये या विश्वावसुं गन्धर्वं सचध्वे ।
ताभ्यो वो देवीर्नम इत् कृणोमि॥
verses.tr: abhriye didyunnakṣatriye yā viśvāvasuṃ gandharvaṃ sacadhve tābhyo vo devīrnama it kṛṇomi
verses.en: Thou, Cloudy! f ye who follow the Gandharva Visvavasu, ye, Starry! [ Lightning-flasher I You, O ye Goddesses, I truly worship.

verses.sa:
याः क्लन्दास्तमिषीचयोऽक्षकामा मनोमुहः ।
ताभ्यो गन्धर्वपत्नीभ्योऽप्सराभ्योऽकरं नमः॥
verses.tr: yāḥ klandāstamiṣīcayo'kṣakāmā manomuhaḥ tābhyo gandharvapatnībhyo'psarābhyo'karaṃ namaḥ
verses.en: Haunters of darkness, shrill in voice, dice-lovers, maddeners of the mind—To these have I paid homage, the Gandharva's wives, Apsarases.

sections.label: A charm in which water is used to cure disease
sections.name: Hymn 3

verses.sa:
अदो यदवधावत्यवत्कमधि पर्वतात्।
तत् ते कृणोमि भेषजं सुभेषजं यथाससि॥
verses.tr: ado yadavadhāvatyavatkamadhi parvatāt tat te kṛṇomi bheṣajaṃ subheṣajaṃ yathāsasi
verses.en: That little spring of water which is running downward from the hill I turn to healing balm for thee that thou mayst be good medicine.

verses.sa:
आदङ्गा कुविदङ्गा शतं या भेषजानि ते ।
तेषामसि त्वमुत्तममनास्रावमरोगणम्॥
verses.tr: ādaṅgā kuvidaṅgā śataṃ yā bheṣajāni te teṣāmasi tvamuttamamanāsrāvamarogaṇam
verses.en: Hither and onward! Well! Come on! Among thy hundred remedies Most excellent of all art thou, curing disease and morbid flow.

verses.sa:
नीचैः खनन्त्यसुरा अरुस्राणमिदं महत्।
तदास्रावस्य भेषजं तदु रोगमनीनशत्॥
verses.tr: nīcaiḥ khanantyasurā arusrāṇamidaṃ mahat tadāsrāvasya bheṣajaṃ tadu rogamanīnaśat
verses.en: The Asuras bury deep in earth this mighty thing that healeth wounds. This is the cure for morbid flow, this driveth malady away.

verses.sa:
उपजीका उद् भरन्ति समुद्रादधि भेषजम्।
तदास्रावस्य भेषजं तदु रोगमशीशमत्॥
verses.tr: upajīkā ud bharanti samudrādadhi bheṣajam tadāsrāvasya bheṣajaṃ tadu rogamaśīśamat
verses.en: The emmets from the water-flood produce this healing medicine: This is the cure for morbid flow, this driveth malady away.

verses.sa:
अरुस्राणमिदं महत् पृथिव्या अध्युद्भृतम्।
तदास्रावस्य भेषजं तदु रोगमनीनशत्॥
verses.tr: arusrāṇamidaṃ mahat pṛthivyā adhyudbhṛtam tadāsrāvasya bheṣajaṃ tadu rogamanīnaśat
verses.en: Mighty is this wound-healing balm: from out the earth was it produced. This is the cure for morbid flow, this driveth malady away.

verses.sa:
शं नो भवन्त्वप ओषधयः शिवाः ।
इन्द्रस्य वज्रो अप हन्तु रक्षस आराद् विसृष्टा इषवः पतन्तु रक्षसाम्॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no bhavantvapa oṣadhayaḥ śivāḥ indrasya vajro apa hantu rakṣasa ārād visṛṣṭā iṣavaḥ patantu rakṣasām
verses.en: Bless us the Waters! be the Plants auspicious! May Indra's thunderbolt drive off the demons. Far from us fall the shafts they shoot against us!

sections.label: A charm to ensure heath and prosperity by wearing a amulet
sections.name: Hymn 4

verses.sa:
दीर्घायुत्वाय बृहते रणायारिष्यन्तो दक्षमाणाः सदैव।
मणिं विष्कन्धदूषणं जङ्गिडं बिभृमो वयम्॥
verses.tr: dīrghāyutvāya bṛhate raṇāyāriṣyanto dakṣamāṇāḥ sadaiva maṇiṃ viṣkandhadūṣaṇaṃ jaṅgiḍaṃ bibhṛmo vayam
verses.en: For length of life, for mighty joy, uninjured, ever showing strength We wear Vishkandha's antidote, the Amulet of Jangida.

verses.sa:
जङ्गिडो जम्भाद् विशराद् विष्कन्धादभिशोचनात्।
मणिः सहस्रवीर्यः परि णः पातु विश्वतः॥
verses.tr: jaṅgiḍo jambhād viśarād viṣkandhādabhiśocanāt maṇiḥ sahasravīryaḥ pari ṇaḥ pātu viśvataḥ
verses.en: Amulet of a thousand powers, Jangida save us, all around, From Jambha, and from Visara, Vishkandha, and tormenting pain.

verses.sa:
अयं विष्कन्धं सहतेऽयं बाधते अत्त्रिणः ।
अयं नो विश्वभेषजो जङ्गिडः पात्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ viṣkandhaṃ sahate'yaṃ bādhate attriṇaḥ ayaṃ no viśvabheṣajo jaṅgiḍaḥ pātvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: This overcomes Vishkandha, this chases the greedy fiends away: May this our panacea, may Jangida save us from distress.

verses.sa:
देवैर्दत्तेन मणिना जङ्गिडेन मयोभुवा ।
विष्कन्धं सर्वा रक्षांसि व्यायामे सहामहे॥
verses.tr: devairdattena maṇinā jaṅgiḍena mayobhuvā viṣkandhaṃ sarvā rakṣāṃsi vyāyāme sahāmahe
verses.en: With e that brings delight, Amulet given by the Gods, We in the conflict overcome Vishkandha and all Rakshasas.

verses.sa:
शणश्च मा जङ्गिडश्च विष्कन्धादभि रक्षताम्।
अरण्यादन्य आभृतः कृष्या अन्यो रसेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: śaṇaśca mā jaṅgiḍaśca viṣkandhādabhi rakṣatām araṇyādanya ābhṛtaḥ kṛṣyā anyo rasebhyaḥ
verses.en: May Cannabis and Jangida preserve me from Vishkandha,—that Brought to us from the forest, this sprung from the saps of husbandry.

verses.sa:
कृत्यादूषिरयं मणिरथो अरातिदूषिः ।
अथो सहस्वान् जङ्गिडः प्र ण आयुंषि तारिषत्॥
verses.tr: kṛtyādūṣirayaṃ maṇiratho arātidūṣiḥ atho sahasvān jaṅgiḍaḥ pra ṇa āyuṃṣi tāriṣat
verses.en: This Amulet destroys the might of magic and malignSo may victorious Jangida prolong the years we have to live.

sections.label: Invitation to, and praise of Indra
sections.name: Hymn 5

verses.sa:
इन्द्र जुषस्व प्र वहा याहि शूर हरिभ्याम्।
पिबा सुतस्य मतेरिह मधोश्चकानश्चारुर्मदाय॥
verses.tr: indra juṣasva pra vahā yāhi śūra haribhyām pibā sutasya materiha madhoścakānaścārurmadāya
verses.en: Indra, be gracious, drive thou forth, come, hero, with the two bay steeds. Taste the libation, hither, enjoying meath and the hymn, come, fair, to the banquet.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र जठरं नव्यो न पृणस्व मधोर्दिवो न।
अस्य सुतस्य स्व१र्णोप त्वा मदाः सुवाचो अगुः॥
verses.tr: indra jaṭharaṃ navyo na pṛṇasva madhordivo na asya sutasya sva1rṇopa tvā madāḥ suvāco aguḥ
verses.en: O Indra, even as one athirst, fill thee with meath as 'twere from heaven. Sweet-toned, the raptures of this juice have come to thee as to the light.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्तुराषाण्मित्रो वृत्रं यो जघान यतीर्न।
बिभेद वलं भृगुर्न ससहे शत्रून् मदे सोमस्य॥
verses.tr: indrasturāṣāṇmitro vṛtraṃ yo jaghāna yatīrna bibheda valaṃ bhṛgurna sasahe śatrūn made somasya
verses.en: Swift-conquering Indra, Mitra-like, smote, as a Yati, Vritra dead. Like Bhrigu he cleft Vala through, and quelled his foes in Soma's rapturous joy.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा विशन्तु सुतास इन्द्र पृणस्व कुक्षी विड्ढि शक्र धियेह्या नः ।
श्रुधी हवं गिरो मे जुषस्वेन्द्र स्वयुग्भिर्मत्स्वेह महे रणाय॥
verses.tr: ā tvā viśantu sutāsa indra pṛṇasva kukṣī viḍḍhi śakra dhiyehyā naḥ śrudhī havaṃ giro me juṣasvendra svayugbhirmatsveha mahe raṇāya
verses.en: O Indra, let the juices enter thee. Fill full thy belly, sate thee, mighty one! Let the hymn bring thee. Hear thou my call, accept the song I sing, here, Indra, with thy friends enjoy thyself, to height of rapture.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य नु प्रा वोचं वीर्याऽणि यानि चकार प्रथमानि वज्री।
अहन्नहिमन्वपस्ततर्द प्र वक्षणा अभिनत् पर्वतानाम्॥
verses.tr: indrasya nu prā vocaṃ vīryā'ṇi yāni cakāra prathamāni vajrī ahannahimanvapastatarda pra vakṣaṇā abhinat parvatānām
verses.en: Now will I tell the manly deeds of Indra, the first that he achieved, the thunder-wielder. He slew the Dragon, then disclosed the waters, and cleft the channels of the mountain torrents.

verses.sa:
अहन्नहिं पर्वते शिश्रियाणं त्वष्टास्मै वज्रं स्वर्यं ऽ ततक्ष ।
वाश्रा इव धेनवः स्यन्दमाना अञ्जः समुद्रमव जग्मुरापः॥
verses.tr: ahannahiṃ parvate śiśriyāṇaṃ tvaṣṭāsmai vajraṃ svaryaṃ ' tatakṣa vāśrā iva dhenavaḥ syandamānā añjaḥ samudramava jagmurāpaḥ
verses.en: He slew the Dragon lying on the mountain: his heavenly bolt of thunder Tvashtar fashioned. Like lowing kine in rapid flow descending the waters glided downward to the ocean.

verses.sa:
वृषायमाणो अवृणीत सोमं त्रिकद्रुकेष्वपिबत् सुतस्य ।
आ सायकं मघवादत्त वज्रमहन्नेनं प्रथमजामहीनाम्॥
verses.tr: vṛṣāyamāṇo avṛṇīta somaṃ trikadrukeṣvapibat sutasya ā sāyakaṃ maghavādatta vajramahannenaṃ prathamajāmahīnām
verses.en: Impetuous as a bull he chose the Soma, and quaffed the juices in three sacred beakers. Maghavan grasped the thunder for his weapon, and smote to death this first-born of the dragons.

sections.label: A prayer to Agni for protection
sections.name: Hymn 6

verses.sa:
समास्त्वाग्न ऋतवो वर्धयन्तु संवत्सरा ऋषयो यानि सत्या।
सं दिव्येन दीदिहि रोचनेन विश्वा आ भाहि प्रदिशश्चतस्रः॥
verses.tr: samāstvāgna ṛtavo vardhayantu saṃvatsarā ṛṣayo yāni satyā saṃ divyena dīdihi rocanena viśvā ā bhāhi pradiśaścatasraḥ
verses.en: Half-years and seasons strengthen thee, O Agni, the years, and all the Verities, and Rishis! Flash forth with thy celestial effulgence: illumine all four regions of the heavens.

verses.sa:
सं चेध्यस्वाग्ने प्र च वर्धयेममुच्च तिष्ठ महते सौभगाय ।
मा ते रिषन्नुपसत्तारो अग्ने ब्रह्माणस्ते यशसः सन्तु मान्ये॥
verses.tr: saṃ cedhyasvāgne pra ca vardhayemamucca tiṣṭha mahate saubhagāya mā te riṣannupasattāro agne brahmāṇaste yaśasaḥ santu mānye
verses.en: Kindle thee, Agni, and make this man prosper: rise up erect for high and happy fortune. Agni, be those uninjured who adore thee, and may thy priests be glorious and no others.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने वृणते ब्राह्मणा इमे शिवो अग्ने संवरणे भवा नः ।
सपत्नहाग्ने अभिमातिजिद् भव स्वे गये जागृह्यप्रयुछन्॥
verses.tr: tvāmagne vṛṇate brāhmaṇā ime śivo agne saṃvaraṇe bhavā naḥ sapatnahāgne abhimātijid bhava sve gaye jāgṛhyaprayuchan
verses.en: These Brahmans have elected thee, O Agni: be thou. propitious in our sacred chamber. Slayer of rivals, Agni, quell our foemen: watch in our house with care that never ceases.

verses.sa:
क्षत्रेणाग्ने स्वेन सं रभस्व मित्रेणाग्ने मित्रधा यतस्व ।
सजातानां मध्यमेष्ठा राज्ञामग्ने विहव्यो दीदिहीह॥
verses.tr: kṣatreṇāgne svena saṃ rabhasva mitreṇāgne mitradhā yatasva sajātānāṃ madhyameṣṭhā rājñāmagne vihavyo dīdihīha
verses.en: Seize, Agni, on thy power and firmly hold it: contend thou with the Friend by way of friendship. Placed in the centre of our fellows, Agni, flash forth to be invoked by kings around thee.

verses.sa:
अति निहो अति सृधोऽत्यचित्तीरति द्विषः ।
विश्वा ह्यऽग्ने दुरिता तर त्वमथास्मभ्यं सहवीरं रयिं दाः॥
verses.tr: ati niho ati sṛdho'tyacittīrati dviṣaḥ viśvā hya'gne duritā tara tvamathāsmabhyaṃ sahavīraṃ rayiṃ dāḥ
verses.en: Past those who slay, past enemies, past thoughtless men, past those who hate,—Yea, Agni, hear us safe past all distresses: give thou us opulence with men about us.

sections.label: A counter-charm against imprecation and malignity
sections.name: Hymn 7

verses.sa:
अघद्विष्टा देवजाता वीरुच्छपथयोपनी ।
आपो मलमिव प्राणैक्षीत् सर्वान् मच्छपथाँ अधि॥
verses.tr: aghadviṣṭā devajātā vīrucchapathayopanī āpo malamiva prāṇaikṣīt sarvān macchapathāṃ adhi
verses.en: Hated by sinners, sprung from Gods, this Plant that turns the curse away Hath washed from me all curses, as water makes clean from spot and stain.

verses.sa:
यश्च सापत्नः शपथो जाम्याः शपथश्च यः ।
ब्रह्मा यन्मन्युतः शपात् सर्वं तन्नो अधस्पदम्॥
verses.tr: yaśca sāpatnaḥ śapatho jāmyāḥ śapathaśca yaḥ brahmā yanmanyutaḥ śapāt sarvaṃ tanno adhaspadam
verses.en: All curses of a rival, each curse of a female relative, Curse uttered by an angry priest, all these we tread beneath our feet.

verses.sa:
दिवो मूलमवततं पृथिव्या अध्युत्ततम्।
तेन सहस्रकाण्डेन परि णः पाहि विश्वतः॥
verses.tr: divo mūlamavatataṃ pṛthivyā adhyuttatam tena sahasrakāṇḍena pari ṇaḥ pāhi viśvataḥ
verses.en: Spread on the surface of the earth, downward from heaven thy root depends: With this that hath a thousand joint keep thou us safe on every side,

verses.sa:
परि मां परि मे प्रजां परि णः पाहि यद्धनम्।
अरातिर्नो मा तारीन्मा नस्तारिषुरभिमातयः॥
verses.tr: pari māṃ pari me prajāṃ pari ṇaḥ pāhi yaddhanam arātirno mā tārīnmā nastāriṣurabhimātayaḥ
verses.en: Guard on all sides this woman, guard my children, us, and all our wealth! Let not malignity o'ercome, nor adversaries conquer us.

verses.sa:
शप्तारमेतु शपथो यः सुहार्त् तेन नः सह।
चक्षुर्मन्त्रस्य दुर्हार्दः पृष्टीरपि शृणीमसि॥
verses.tr: śaptārametu śapatho yaḥ suhārt tena naḥ saha cakṣurmantrasya durhārdaḥ pṛṣṭīrapi śṛṇīmasi
verses.en: Upon the curser fall his curse! Dwell we with him whose heart is true! We split the cruel villain's ribs whose evil eye bewitches us.

sections.label: A charm against hereditary disease (kshatriya)
sections.name: Hymn 8

verses.sa:
उदगातां भगवती विचृतौ नाम तारके ।
वि क्षेत्रियस्य मुञ्चतामधमं पाशमुत्तमम्॥
verses.tr: udagātāṃ bhagavatī vicṛtau nāma tārake vi kṣetriyasya muñcatāmadhamaṃ pāśamuttamam
verses.en: Twin Stars of happy omen, named Releasers, have gone up. May they Loose, of inherited disease, the uppermost and lowest bond.

verses.sa:
अपेयं रात्र्युच्छत्वपोच्छन्त्वभिकृत्वरीः ।
वीरुत् क्षेत्रियनाशन्यप क्षेत्रियमुच्छतु॥
verses.tr: apeyaṃ rātryucchatvapocchantvabhikṛtvarīḥ vīrut kṣetriyanāśanyapa kṣetriyamucchatu
verses.en: Vanish this Night, extinct in Dawn! Let those who weave their spells depart. So let the plague-destroying Plant remove inherited disease.

verses.sa:
बभ्रोरर्जुनकाण्डस्य यवस्य ते पलाल्या तिलस्य तिलपिञ्ज्या।
वीरुत् क्षेत्रियनाशन्यप क्षेत्रियमुच्छतु॥
verses.tr: babhrorarjunakāṇḍasya yavasya te palālyā tilasya tilapiñjyā vīrut kṣetriyanāśanyapa kṣetriyamucchatu
verses.en: With straw of barley tawny-brown in colour with its silvery ears, with stalk and stem of Sesamum—So let the plague-destroying Plant remove inherited disease.

verses.sa:
नमस्ते लाङ्गलेभ्यो नम ईषायुगेभ्यः ।
वीरुत् क्षेत्रियनाशन्यप क्षेत्रियमुच्छतु॥
verses.tr: namaste lāṅgalebhyo nama īṣāyugebhyaḥ vīrut kṣetriyanāśanyapa kṣetriyamucchatu
verses.en: Let homage to thy ploughs be paid, our homage to-the pole and yokes. So let the plague-destroying Plant remove inherited disease.

verses.sa:
नमः सनिस्रसाक्षेभ्यो नमः संदेश्येऽभ्यः ।
नमः क्षेत्रस्य पतये वीरुत् क्षेत्रियनाशन्यप क्षेत्रियमुछतु॥
verses.tr: namaḥ sanisrasākṣebhyo namaḥ saṃdeśye'bhyaḥ namaḥ kṣetrasya pataye vīrut kṣetriyanāśanyapa kṣetriyamuchatu
verses.en: Homage to men with blinking eyes, homage to those who hear and act! To the Field's Lord be homage paid. So let the plague-destroying Plant remove inherited; disease.

sections.label: A charm to cure dangerous disease
sections.name: Hymn 9

verses.sa:
दशवृक्ष मुञ्चेमं रक्षसो ग्राह्या अधि यैनं जग्राह पर्वसु ।
अथो एनं वनस्पते जीवानां लोकमुन्नय॥
verses.tr: daśavṛkṣa muñcemaṃ rakṣaso grāhyā adhi yainaṃ jagrāha parvasu atho enaṃ vanaspate jīvānāṃ lokamunnaya
verses.en: Free this man, Dasavriksha! from the demon, from Grahi who hath seized his joints and members, And raise him up again, O Tree, into the world of living men.

verses.sa:
आगादुदगादयं जीवानां व्रातमप्यगात्।
अभूदु पुत्राणां पिता नृणां च भगवत्तमः॥
verses.tr: āgādudagādayaṃ jīvānāṃ vrātamapyagāt abhūdu putrāṇāṃ pitā nṛṇāṃ ca bhagavattamaḥ
verses.en: He hath arisen and come once more, rejoined the band of those who live. May he become the sire of sons, and of all men most fortunate.

verses.sa:
अधीतीरध्यगादयमधि जीवपुरा अगान्।
शतं ह्यस्य भिषजः सहस्रमुत वीरुधः॥
verses.tr: adhītīradhyagādayamadhi jīvapurā agān śataṃ hyasya bhiṣajaḥ sahasramuta vīrudhaḥ
verses.en: He hath returned to consciousness, rejoined the living's firm abodes, For hundred leeches are in this, yea, and a thousand healing herbs.

verses.sa:
देवास्ते चीतिमविदन् ब्रह्माण उत वीरुधः ।
चीतिं ते विश्वे देवा अविदन् भूम्यामधि॥
verses.tr: devāste cītimavidan brahmāṇa uta vīrudhaḥ cītiṃ te viśve devā avidan bhūmyāmadhi
verses.en: The Gods, the Brahman-priests, and plants observed the way to gather thee: All deities descried the way men gather thee upon the earth.

verses.sa:
यश्चकार स निष्करत् स एव सुभिषक्तमः ।
स एव तुभ्यं भेषजानि कृणवद् भिषजा शुचिः॥
verses.tr: yaścakāra sa niṣkarat sa eva subhiṣaktamaḥ sa eva tubhyaṃ bheṣajāni kṛṇavad bhiṣajā śuciḥ
verses.en: Let him who made it also heal: he, truly, is the deftest leech. Pure, with a leech he verily shall give thee medicines that heal.

sections.label: Absolution and benediction
sections.name: Hymn 10

verses.sa:
क्षेत्रियात् त्वा निरृत्या जामिशंसाद् द्रुहो मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशात्।
अनागसं ब्रह्मणा त्वा कृणोमि शिवे ते द्यावा पृथिवी उभे स्ताम्॥
verses.tr: kṣetriyāt tvā nirṛtyā jāmiśaṃsād druho muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśāt anāgasaṃ brahmaṇā tvā kṛṇomi śive te dyāvā pṛthivī ubhe stām
verses.en: From family sickness, kinsmen's curse, Destruction, from Druh, from Varuna noose I free and save thee. With spell and prayer I make thee pure and sinless: to thee be both, the Earth and Heaven, auspicious!

verses.sa:
शं ते अग्निः सहाद्भिरस्तु शं सोमः सहौषधीभिः ।
एवाहं त्वां क्षेत्रियान्निरृत्या जामिशंसाद् द्रुहो मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशात्।
अनागसं ब्रह्मणा त्वा कृणोमि शिवे ते द्यावापृथिवी उभे स्ताम्॥
verses.tr: śaṃ te agniḥ sahādbhirastu śaṃ somaḥ sahauṣadhībhiḥ evāhaṃ tvāṃ kṣetriyānnirṛtyā jāmiśaṃsād druho muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśāt anāgasaṃ brahmaṇā tvā kṛṇomi śive te dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe stām
verses.en: Gracious to thee be Agni with the Waters, let Soma with the Plants be kind and bless thee. From family sickness, kinsmen's curse, Destruction, from Druh, from Varuna's noose I thus release thee.

verses.sa:
शं ते वातो अन्तरिक्षे वयो धाच्छं ते भवन्तु प्रदिशश्चतस्रः ।
एवाहं त्वां क्षेत्रियान्निरृत्या जामिशंसाद् द्रुहो मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशात्।
अनागसं ब्रह्मणा त्वा कृणोमि शिवे ते द्यावापृथिवी उभे स्ताम्॥
verses.tr: śaṃ te vāto antarikṣe vayo dhācchaṃ te bhavantu pradiśaścatasraḥ evāhaṃ tvāṃ kṣetriyānnirṛtyā jāmiśaṃsād druho muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśāt anāgasaṃ brahmaṇā tvā kṛṇomi śive te dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe stām
verses.en: May kind Wind strengthen thee in air's mid-region, to thee may heaven's four quarters be auspicious. From family sickness, kinsmen's curse, Destruction, from Druh, from Varuna's curse I thus release thee.

verses.sa:
इमा या देवीः प्रदिशश्चतस्रो वातपत्नीरभि सूर्यो विचष्टे ।
एवाहं त्वां क्षेत्रियान्निरृ त्या जामिशंसाद् द्रुहो मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशात्।
अनागसं ब्रह्मणा त्वा कृणोमि शिवे ते द्यावापृथिवी उभे स्ताम्॥
verses.tr: imā yā devīḥ pradiśaścatasro vātapatnīrabhi sūryo vicaṣṭe evāhaṃ tvāṃ kṣetriyānnirṛ tyā jāmiśaṃsād druho muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśāt anāgasaṃ brahmaṇā tvā kṛṇomi śive te dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe stām
verses.en: These Goddesses, four regions of the heavens, on whom the Sun looks kindly, wives of Vata—From family sickness, kinsmen's curse, Destruction, from Druh, from Varuna's noose I thus release thee.

verses.sa:
तासु त्वान्तर्जरस्या दधामि प्र यक्ष्म एतु निरृतिः पराचैः ।
एवाहं त्वां क्षेत्रियान्निरृत्या जामिशंसाद् द्रुहो मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशात्।
अनागसं ब्रह्मणा त्वा कृणोमि शिवे ते द्यावापृथिवी उभे स्ताम्॥
verses.tr: tāsu tvāntarjarasyā dadhāmi pra yakṣma etu nirṛtiḥ parācaiḥ evāhaṃ tvāṃ kṣetriyānnirṛtyā jāmiśaṃsād druho muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśāt anāgasaṃ brahmaṇā tvā kṛṇomi śive te dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe stām
verses.en: For long life, in the midst of these I set thee. Away pass Nirriti, away Consumption! From family sickness, kinsmen's curse, Destruction, from Druh, from Varuna's noose I thus release thee.

verses.sa:
अमुक्था यक्ष्माद् दुरितादवद्याद् द्रुहः पाशाद् ग्राह्याश्चोदमुक्थाः ।
एवाहं त्वां क्षेत्रियान्निरृत्या जामिशंसाद् द्रुहो मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशात्।
अनागसं ब्रह्मणा त्वा कृणोमि शिवे ते द्यावापृथिवी उभे स्ताम्॥
verses.tr: amukthā yakṣmād duritādavadyād druhaḥ pāśād grāhyāścodamukthāḥ evāhaṃ tvāṃ kṣetriyānnirṛtyā jāmiśaṃsād druho muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśāt anāgasaṃ brahmaṇā tvā kṛṇomi śive te dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe stām
verses.en: Thou hast been freed from Phthisis and from trouble, from shame, and from the snare of Druh and Grahi. From family sickness, kinsmen's curse, Destruction, from Druh, from Varuna's noose I thus release thee.

verses.sa:
अहा अरातिमविदः स्योनमप्यभूर्भद्रे सुकृतस्य लोके।
एवाहं त्वां क्षेत्रियान्निरृत्या जामिशंसाद् द्रुहो मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशात्।
अनागसं ब्रह्मणा त्वा कृणोमि शिवे ते द्यावापृथिवी उभे स्ताम्॥
verses.tr: ahā arātimavidaḥ syonamapyabhūrbhadre sukṛtasya loke evāhaṃ tvāṃ kṣetriyānnirṛtyā jāmiśaṃsād druho muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśāt anāgasaṃ brahmaṇā tvā kṛṇomi śive te dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe stām
verses.en: Joy hast thou found, and left ill-will behind thee: thou hast attained the happy world of virtue. From family sickness, kinsmen's curse, Destruction, from Druh, from Varuna's noose I thus release thee.

verses.sa:
सूर्यमृतं तमसो ग्राह्या अधि देवा मुञ्चन्तो असृजन्निरेणसः ।
एवाहं त्वां क्षेत्रियान्निरृत्या जामिशंसाद् द्रुहो मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशात्।
अनागसं ब्रह्मणा त्वा कृणोमि शिवे ते द्यावापृथिवी उभे स्ताम्॥
verses.tr: sūryamṛtaṃ tamaso grāhyā adhi devā muñcanto asṛjannireṇasaḥ evāhaṃ tvāṃ kṣetriyānnirṛtyā jāmiśaṃsād druho muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśāt anāgasaṃ brahmaṇā tvā kṛṇomi śive te dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe stām
verses.en: The Gods have freed from sinfulness, redeeming the Sun, the Law from darkness and from Grahi. From family sickness, kinsmen's curse, Destruction, from Druh, from Varuna's noose I thus release thee. "With spell and prayer I make thee pure and sinless: to thee be both, the Earth and Heaven, auspicious!

sections.label: Counter-charm, with an amulet, against an enemy's spell
sections.name: Hymn 11

verses.sa:
दूष्या दूषिरसि हेत्या हेतिरसि मेन्या मेनिरसि ।
आप्नुहि श्रेयांसमति समं क्राम॥
verses.tr: dūṣyā dūṣirasi hetyā hetirasi menyā menirasi āpnuhi śreyāṃsamati samaṃ krāma
verses.en: Dart against dart, destroyer of destruction, thou art the missile sent to meet the missile. Reach thy superior, thou; surpass thine equal.

verses.sa:
स्रक्त्योऽसि प्रतिसरोऽसि प्रत्यभिचरणोऽसि ।
आप्नुहि श्रेयांसमति समं क्राम॥
verses.tr: sraktyo'si pratisaro'si pratyabhicaraṇo'si āpnuhi śreyāṃsamati samaṃ krāma
verses.en: Sraktya art thou, an Amulet art thou, a counter-charm of spells. Reach thy superior, thou; surpass thine equal.

verses.sa:
प्रति तमभि चर योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ।
आप्नुहि श्रेयांसमति समं क्राम॥
verses.tr: prati tamabhi cara yo'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ āpnuhi śreyāṃsamati samaṃ krāma
verses.en: Use spells against the man we hate, against the man who hateth us. Reach thy superior, thou; surpass thine equal.

verses.sa:
सूरिरसि वर्चोधा असि तनूपानोऽसि ।
आप्नुहि श्रेयांसमति समं क्राम॥
verses.tr: sūrirasi varcodhā asi tanūpāno'si āpnuhi śreyāṃsamati samaṃ krāma
verses.en: A prince art thou, giver of speech, thou art our bodies' strong defence, Reach thy superior, thou; surpass thine equal.

verses.sa:
शुक्रोऽसि भ्राजोऽसि स्वऽरसि ज्योतिरसि ।
आप्नुहि श्रेयांसमति समं क्राम॥
verses.tr: śukro'si bhrājo'si sva'rasi jyotirasi āpnuhi śreyāṃsamati samaṃ krāma
verses.en: Fulgent art thou, and splendid, thou art heavenly lustre, thou art light. Reach thy superior, thou; surpass thine equal,

sections.label: A prayer for vengeance on a malicious rival worshipper
sections.name: Hymn 12

verses.sa:
द्यावापृथिवी उर्व१न्तरिक्षं क्षेत्रस्य पत्न्युरुगायोऽद्भुतः ।
उतान्तरिक्षमुरु वातगोपं त इह तप्यन्तां मयि तप्यमाने॥
verses.tr: dyāvāpṛthivī urva1ntarikṣaṃ kṣetrasya patnyurugāyo'dbhutaḥ utāntarikṣamuru vātagopaṃ ta iha tapyantāṃ mayi tapyamāne
verses.en: The spacious Firmament, and Earth and Heaven, the Field's Queen, and the wonderful Wide-strider, Yea, the broad middle air which Vata guardeth, may these now burn with heat while I am burning.

verses.sa:
इदं देवाः शृणुत ये यज्ञिया स्थ भरद्वाजो मह्यमुक्थानि शंसति ।
पाशे स बद्धो दुरिते नि युज्यतां यो अस्माकं मन इदं हिनस्ति॥
verses.tr: idaṃ devāḥ śṛṇuta ye yajñiyā stha bharadvājo mahyamukthāni śaṃsati pāśe sa baddho durite ni yujyatāṃ yo asmākaṃ mana idaṃ hinasti
verses.en: Listen to this, ye Gods who merit worship. Hymns here are sung for me by Bharadvaja. Bound in the noose may he be doomed to trouble whoever mars this that our mind hath purposed.

verses.sa:
इदमिन्द्र शृणुहि सोमप यत् त्वा हृदा शोचता जोहवीमि ।
वृश्चामि तं कुलिशेनेव वृक्षं यो अस्माकं मन इदं हिनस्ति॥
verses.tr: idamindra śṛṇuhi somapa yat tvā hṛdā śocatā johavīmi vṛścāmi taṃ kuliśeneva vṛkṣaṃ yo asmākaṃ mana idaṃ hinasti
verses.en: Hear this my call, O Indra, Soma-drinker, as with a burning heart I oft invoke thee. I smite, as 'twere a tree felled with a hatchet, the man who marketh this my plan and purpose.

verses.sa:
अशीतिभिस्तिसृभिः सामगेभिरादित्येभिर्वसुभिरङ्गिरोभिः ।
इष्टापूर्तमवतु नः पितॄणामामुं ददे हरसा दैव्येन॥
verses.tr: aśītibhistisṛbhiḥ sāmagebhirādityebhirvasubhiraṅgirobhiḥ iṣṭāpūrtamavatu naḥ pitṝṇāmāmuṃ dade harasā daivyena
verses.en: Together with thrice-eighty Sama-singers, Angirases, and Vasus, and Adityas, May the felicity of the Fathers guard us. I seize that man with fire that Gods have kindled.

verses.sa:
द्यावापृथिवी अनु मा दीधीथां विश्वे देवासो अनु मा रभध्वम्।
अङ्गिरसः पितरः सोम्यासः पापमार्छत्वपकामस्य कर्ता॥
verses.tr: dyāvāpṛthivī anu mā dīdhīthāṃ viśve devāso anu mā rabhadhvam aṅgirasaḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ pāpamārchatvapakāmasya kartā
verses.en: O Heaven and Earth, regard me with your favour, and, all ye Gods, stand on my side and help me. Angirases, Fathers worthy of the Soma! woe fall on him who caused the hateful outrage!

verses.sa:
अतीव यो मरुतो मन्यते नो ब्रह्म वा यो निन्दिषत् क्रियमाणम्।
तपूंषि तस्मै वृजिनानि सन्तु ब्रह्मद्विषं द्यौरभिसंतपाति॥
verses.tr: atīva yo maruto manyate no brahma vā yo nindiṣat kriyamāṇam tapūṃṣi tasmai vṛjināni santu brahmadviṣaṃ dyaurabhisaṃtapāti
verses.en: Whoever either scorns us, O ye Maruts, or blames devotion which we now are paying, Let his own wicked deeds be fires to burn him. May Heaven consume the man who hates devotion.

verses.sa:
सप्त प्राणानष्टौ मन्यस्तांस्ते वृश्चामि ब्रह्मणा ।
अया यमस्य सादनमग्निदूतो अरंकृतः॥
verses.tr: sapta prāṇānaṣṭau manyastāṃste vṛścāmi brahmaṇā ayā yamasya sādanamagnidūto araṃkṛtaḥ
verses.en: Thy sevenfold vital breath, thine eight marrows I rend away with prayer. With Agni as thine envoy, go, prepared, to Yama's dwelling-place.

verses.sa:
आ दधामि ते पदं समिद्धे जातवेदसि ।
अग्निः शरीरं वेवेष्ट्वसुं वागपि गछतु॥
verses.tr: ā dadhāmi te padaṃ samiddhe jātavedasi agniḥ śarīraṃ veveṣṭvasuṃ vāgapi gachatu
verses.en: In Jatavedas' kindled flame I set the place assigned to thee. Let fire consume thy body, and thy voice go to the general breath.

sections.label: A youth's Investiture ceremony (godanam)
sections.name: Hymn 13

verses.sa:
आयुर्दा अग्ने जरसं वृणानो घृतप्रतीको घृतपृष्ठो अग्ने ।
घृतं पीत्वा मधु चारु गव्यं पितेव पुत्रानभि रक्षतादिमम्॥
verses.tr: āyurdā agne jarasaṃ vṛṇāno ghṛtapratīko ghṛtapṛṣṭho agne ghṛtaṃ pītvā madhu cāru gavyaṃ piteva putrānabhi rakṣatādimam
verses.en: Strength-giver, winning lengthened life, O Agni, with face and back shining with molten butter, Drink thou the butter and fair milk and honey, and, as a sire his sons, keep this man safely.

verses.sa:
परि धत्त धत्त नो वर्चसेमं जरामृत्युं कृणुत दीर्घमायुः ।
बृहस्पतिः प्रायच्छद् वास एतत् सोमाय राज्ञे परिधातवा उ॥
verses.tr: pari dhatta dhatta no varcasemaṃ jarāmṛtyuṃ kṛṇuta dīrghamāyuḥ bṛhaspatiḥ prāyacchad vāsa etat somāya rājñe paridhātavā u
verses.en: For us surround him, cover him with splendour, give him long life, and death when age removes him. The garment hath Brihaspati presented to Soma, to the King, to wrap about him.

verses.sa:
परीदं वासो अधिथाः स्वस्तयेऽभूर्गृष्टीनामभिशस्तिपा उ ।
शतं च जीव शरदः पुरूची रायश्च पोषमुपसंव्ययस्व॥
verses.tr: parīdaṃ vāso adhithāḥ svastaye'bhūrgṛṣṭīnāmabhiśastipā u śataṃ ca jīva śaradaḥ purūcī rāyaśca poṣamupasaṃvyayasva
verses.en: Thou for our weal hast clothed thee in the mantle: thou hast become our heifers' guard from witchcraft. Live thou a hundred full and plenteous autumns, and wrap thee in prosperity of riches.

verses.sa:
एह्यश्मानमा तिष्ठाश्मा भवतु ते तनूः ।
कृण्वन्तु विश्वे देवा आयुष्टे शरदः शतम्॥
verses.tr: ehyaśmānamā tiṣṭhāśmā bhavatu te tanūḥ kṛṇvantu viśve devā āyuṣṭe śaradaḥ śatam
verses.en: Come hither, stand upon the stone: thy body shall become a stone. The Universal Gods shall make thy life a hundred autumns long.

verses.sa:
यस्य ते वासः प्रथमवास्यं१ हरामस्तं त्वा विश्वेऽवन्तु देवाः ।
तं त्वा भ्रातरः सुवृधा वर्धमानमनु जातन्तां बहवः सुजातम्॥
verses.tr: yasya te vāsaḥ prathamavāsyaṃ1 harāmastaṃ tvā viśve'vantu devāḥ taṃ tvā bhrātaraḥ suvṛdhā vardhamānamanu jātantāṃ bahavaḥ sujātam
verses.en: So may the Universal Gods protect thee, whom we divest of raiment worn aforetime. So after thee, well-formed and growing stronger, be born a multitude of thriving brothers.

sections.label: A charm to banish vermin and noxious creatures
sections.name: Hymn 14

verses.sa:
निःसालां धृष्णुं धिषणमेकवाद्यां जिघत्स्वऽम्।
सर्वाश्चण्डस्य नप्त्योऽ नाशयामः सदान्वाः॥
verses.tr: niḥsālāṃ dhṛṣṇuṃ dhiṣaṇamekavādyāṃ jighatsva'm sarvāścaṇḍasya naptyo' nāśayāmaḥ sadānvāḥ
verses.en: Forth from the hall the bold, the sharp, the greedy one, the single- voiced, Sadanvas and all progeny of Chanda we exterminate.

verses.sa:
निर्वो गोष्ठादजामसि निरक्षान्निरुपानसात्।
निर्वो मगुन्द्या दुहितरो गृहेभ्यश्चातयामहे॥
verses.tr: nirvo goṣṭhādajāmasi nirakṣānnirupānasāt nirvo magundyā duhitaro gṛhebhyaścātayāmahe
verses.en: We drive you forth from cattle-shed, from axle, from within the wain, Ye daughters of Magundi, we frighten and chase you from our homes.

verses.sa:
असौ यो अधराद् गृहस्तत्र सन्त्वराय्यः ।
तत्र सेदिर्न्युऽच्यतु सर्वाश्च यातुधान्यः॥
verses.tr: asau yo adharād gṛhastatra santvarāyyaḥ tatra sedirnyu'cyatu sarvāśca yātudhānyaḥ
verses.en: Yonder let the Arayis dwell, there where that house is down below. Let utter indigence and all the Yatudhanis settle there.

verses.sa:
भूतपतिर्निरजत्विन्द्रश्चेतः सदान्वाः ।
गृहस्य बुध्न आसीनास्ता इन्द्रो वज्रेणाधि तिष्ठतु॥
verses.tr: bhūtapatirnirajatvindraścetaḥ sadānvāḥ gṛhasya budhna āsīnāstā indro vajreṇādhi tiṣṭhatu
verses.en: May Bhutapati drive away, and Indra, the Sadanvas once. Let Indra with his bolt quell those who sit upon our dwelling's floor,

verses.sa:
यदि स्थ क्षेत्रियाणां यदि वा पुरुषेषिताः ।
यदि स्थ दस्युभ्यो जाता नश्यतेतः सदान्वाः॥
verses.tr: yadi stha kṣetriyāṇāṃ yadi vā puruṣeṣitāḥ yadi stha dasyubhyo jātā naśyatetaḥ sadānvāḥ
verses.en: Whether ye be of farm and field, or whether ye be sent by men, Or be ye sprung from Dasyu race, vanish, Sadanvas, and begone.

verses.sa:
परि धामान्यासामाशुर्गाष्ठामिवासरन्।
अजैषं सर्वानाजीन्वो नश्यतेतः सदान्वाः॥
verses.tr: pari dhāmānyāsāmāśurgāṣṭhāmivāsaran ajaiṣaṃ sarvānājīnvo naśyatetaḥ sadānvāḥ
verses.en: I have gone round their homes as runs a fleet-foot racer round the post, And in all races conquered you. Vanish, Sadanvas, and begone.

sections.label: A charm against fear
sections.name: Hymn 15

verses.sa: यथा द्यौश्च पृथिवी च न बिभीतो न रिष्यतः । एवा मे प्राण मा बिभेः॥
verses.tr: yathā dyauśca pṛthivī ca na bibhīto na riṣyataḥ evā me prāṇa mā bibheḥ
verses.en: As 'Heaven and Earth are not afraid, fc and never suffer loss or harm, Even so, my spirit, fear not thou,

verses.sa: यथाहश्च रात्री च न बिभीतो न रिष्यतः । एवा मे प्राण मा बिभेः॥
verses.tr: yathāhaśca rātrī ca na bibhīto na riṣyataḥ evā me prāṇa mā bibheḥ
verses.en: As Day. and Night are not afraid, nor ever suffer loss or harm, Even so, my spirit, fear not thou.

verses.sa: यथा सूर्यश्च चन्द्रश्च न बिभीतो न रिष्यतः । एवा मे प्राण मा बिभेः॥
verses.tr: yathā sūryaśca candraśca na bibhīto na riṣyataḥ evā me prāṇa mā bibheḥ
verses.en: As Sun and Moon are not afraid, nor ever suffer loss or harm, Even so, my spirit, fear not thou.

verses.sa: यथा ब्रह्म च क्षत्रं च न बिभीतो न रिष्यतः । एवा मे प्राण मा बिभेः॥
verses.tr: yathā brahma ca kṣatraṃ ca na bibhīto na riṣyataḥ evā me prāṇa mā bibheḥ
verses.en: As Brahmanhood and Princely Power fear not, nor suffer loss or harm, Even so, my spirit, fear not thou.

verses.sa: यथा सत्यं चानृतं च न बिभीतो न रिष्यतः । एवा मे प्राण मा बिभेः॥
verses.tr: yathā satyaṃ cānṛtaṃ ca na bibhīto na riṣyataḥ evā me prāṇa mā bibheḥ
verses.en: As Truth and Falsehood have no fear, nor ever suffer loss or harm, Even so, my spirit, fear not thou.

verses.sa: यथा भूतं च भव्यं च न बिभीतो न रिष्यतः । एवा मे प्राण मा बिभेः॥
verses.tr: yathā bhūtaṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca na bibhīto na riṣyataḥ evā me prāṇa mā bibheḥ
verses.en: As What Hath Been and What Shall Be fear not, nor suffer loss or harm, Even so, my spirit, fear not thou.

sections.label: A prayer for general protection
sections.name: Hymn 16

verses.sa: प्राणापानौ मृत्योर्मा पातं स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: prāṇāpānau mṛtyormā pātaṃ svāhā
verses.en: Guard me from death, Inhaling and Exhaling! All bliss to you!

verses.sa: द्यावापृथिवी उपश्रुत्या मा पातं स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: dyāvāpṛthivī upaśrutyā mā pātaṃ svāhā
verses.en: Guard me from overhearing, Earth and Heaven! All hail to you!

verses.sa: सूर्य चक्षुषा मा पाहि स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: sūrya cakṣuṣā mā pāhi svāhā
verses.en: Do thou, O Surya, with thine eye protect me! All hail to thee!

verses.sa: अग्ने वैश्वानर विश्वैर्मा देवैः पाहि स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: agne vaiśvānara viśvairmā devaiḥ pāhi svāhā
verses.en: Agni Vaisvanara, with all Gods preserve me! All hail to thee!

verses.sa: विश्वंभर विश्वेन मा भरसा पाहि स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: viśvaṃbhara viśvena mā bharasā pāhi svāhā
verses.en: Preserve me with all care, O All-sustainer! All hail to thee!

sections.label: A prayer to an amulet for health and strength
sections.name: Hymn 17

verses.sa: ओजोऽस्योजो मे दाः स्वाहा ॥
verses.tr: ojo'syojo me dāḥ svāhā
verses.en: Power art thou, give me power. All hail!

verses.sa: सहोऽसि सहो मे दाः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: saho'si saho me dāḥ svāhā
verses.en: Might art thou, give me might. All hail!

verses.sa: बलमसि बलं मे दाः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: balamasi balaṃ me dāḥ svāhā
verses.en: Strength art thou, give me strength. All hail!

verses.sa: आयुरस्यायुर्मे दाः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: āyurasyāyurme dāḥ svāhā
verses.en: Life art thou, give me life. All hail!

verses.sa: श्रोत्रमसि श्रोत्रं मे दाः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: śrotramasi śrotraṃ me dāḥ svāhā
verses.en: Ear art thou, give me hearing! Hail!

verses.sa: चक्षुरसि चक्षुर्मे दाः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: cakṣurasi cakṣurme dāḥ svāhā
verses.en: Eye art thou, give me eyes. All hail!

verses.sa: परिपाणमसि परिपाणं मे दाः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: paripāṇamasi paripāṇaṃ me dāḥ svāhā
verses.en: Shield art thou, shield me well. All hail!

sections.label: A charm against enemies, goblins, and other evil creature
sections.name: Hymn 18

verses.sa: भ्रातृव्यक्षयणमसि भ्रातृव्यचातनं मे दाः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: bhrātṛvyakṣayaṇamasi bhrātṛvyacātanaṃ me dāḥ svāhā
verses.en: Destruction of the foe art thou, give me the scaring of my foes. All hail!

verses.sa: सपत्नक्षयणमसि सपत्नचातनं मे दाः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: sapatnakṣayaṇamasi sapatnacātanaṃ me dāḥ svāhā
verses.en: The rival's ruiner art thou, give me to drive my rivals off. All hail!

verses.sa: अरायक्षयणमस्यरायचातनं मे दाः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: arāyakṣayaṇamasyarāyacātanaṃ me dāḥ svāhā
verses.en: Arayas ruiner art thou, give me to drive Arayis off. All hail!

verses.sa: पिशाचक्षयणमसि पिशाचचातनं मे दाः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: piśācakṣayaṇamasi piśācacātanaṃ me dāḥ svāhā
verses.en: Pisachas' ruiner art thou, give me to drive Pisachas off. All hail!

verses.sa: सदान्वाक्षयणमसि सदान्वाचातनं मे दाः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: sadānvākṣayaṇamasi sadānvācātanaṃ me dāḥ svāhā
verses.en: Sadanvas' ruiner art thou, give me to drive Sadanvas off. All hail!

sections.label: A prayer to Agni for aid against an enemy
sections.name: Hymn 19

verses.sa: अग्ने यत् ते तपस्तेन तं प्रति तप यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
verses.tr: agne yat te tapastena taṃ prati tapa yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
verses.en: Burn thou, O Agni, with that heat of thine against the man who hates us, whom we hate.

verses.sa: अग्ने यत् ते हरस्तेन तं प्रति हर यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
verses.tr: agne yat te harastena taṃ prati hara yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
verses.en: Flame thou, O Agni, with that flame of thine against the man who hates us, whom we hate.

verses.sa: अग्ने यत् तेऽर्चिस्तेन तं प्रत्यर्च यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
verses.tr: agne yat te'rcistena taṃ pratyarca yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
verses.en: Shine out, O Agni, with that sheen of thine against the man who hates us, whom we hate.

verses.sa: अग्ने यत् ते शोचिस्तेन तं प्रति शोच यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
verses.tr: agne yat te śocistena taṃ prati śoca yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
verses.en: Blaze thou, O Agni, with that blaze of thine against the man who hates us, whom we hate.

verses.sa: अग्ने यत् ते तेजस्तेन तमतेजसं कृणु यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
verses.tr: agne yat te tejastena tamatejasaṃ kṛṇu yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
verses.en: O Agni, with the splendour that is thine darken the man who hates us, whom we hate.

sections.label: Repetition of Hymn 19, addressed to Vayu instead of Agni
sections.name: Hymn 20

verses.sa:
वायो यत् ते तपस्तेन तं प्रति तप यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
वायो यत् ते हरस्तेन तं प्रति हर यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
वायो यत् तेऽर्चिस्तेन तं प्रत्यर्च यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
वायो यत् ते शोचिस्तेन तं प्रति शोच यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
वायो यत् ते तेजस्तेन तमतेजसं कृणु यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
verses.tr: vāyo yat te tapastena taṃ prati tapa yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ vāyo yat te harastena taṃ prati hara yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ vāyo yat te'rcistena taṃ pratyarca yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ vāyo yat te śocistena taṃ prati śoca yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ vāyo yat te tejastena tamatejasaṃ kṛṇu yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
verses.en: [Griffith does not print this hymn. His note on Hymn 19: 'A non-metrical charm invoking Agni's aid against an enemy. Hymns XX-XXIII are exactly similar except that other deities, Vayu, Surya, Chandra or the Moon, and the Waters, are addressed instead of Agni.' Here Vayu is addressed.]

sections.label: Repetition of Hymn 19, addressed to Surya instead of Agni
sections.name: Hymn 21

verses.sa:
सूर्य यत् ते तपस्तेन तं प्रति तप यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
सूर्य यत् ते हरस्तेन तं प्रति हर यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
सूर्य यत् तेऽर्चिस्तेन तं प्रत्यर्च यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
सूर्य यत् ते शोचिस्तेन तं प्रति शोच यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
सूर्य यत् ते तेजस्तेन तमतेजसं कृणु यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
verses.tr: sūrya yat te tapastena taṃ prati tapa yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ sūrya yat te harastena taṃ prati hara yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ sūrya yat te'rcistena taṃ pratyarca yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ sūrya yat te śocistena taṃ prati śoca yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ sūrya yat te tejastena tamatejasaṃ kṛṇu yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
verses.en: [Griffith does not print this hymn: it is Hymn 19 with Surya addressed instead of Agni.]

sections.label: Repetition of Hymn 19, addressed to Chandra, the Moon, instead of Agni
sections.name: Hymn 22

verses.sa:
चन्द्र यत् ते तपस्तेन तं प्रति तप यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
चन्द्र यत् ते हरस्तेन तं प्रति हर यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
चन्द्र यत् तेऽर्चिस्तेन तं प्रत्यर्च यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
चन्द्र यत् ते शोचिस्तेन तं प्रति शोच यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
चन्द्र यत् ते तेजस्तेन तमतेजसं कृणु यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
verses.tr: candra yat te tapastena taṃ prati tapa yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ candra yat te harastena taṃ prati hara yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ candra yat te'rcistena taṃ pratyarca yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ candra yat te śocistena taṃ prati śoca yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ candra yat te tejastena tamatejasaṃ kṛṇu yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
verses.en: [Griffith does not print this hymn: it is Hymn 19 with Chandra, the Moon, addressed instead of Agni.]

sections.label: Repetition of Hymn 19, addressed to the Waters instead of Agni
sections.name: Hymn 23

verses.sa:
आपो यद् वस्तपस्तेन तं प्रति तपत यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
आपो यद् वो हरस्तेन तं प्रति हरत यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
आपो यद् वोऽर्चिस्तेन तं प्रत्यर्चत यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
आपो यद् वः शोचिस्तेन तं प्रति शोचत यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
आपो यद् वस्तेजस्तेन तमतेजसं कृणुत यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः॥
verses.tr: āpo yad vastapastena taṃ prati tapata yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ āpo yad vo harastena taṃ prati harata yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ āpo yad vo'rcistena taṃ pratyarcata yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ āpo yad vaḥ śocistena taṃ prati śocata yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ āpo yad vastejastena tamatejasaṃ kṛṇuta yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
verses.en: [Griffith does not print this hymn: it is Hymn 19 with the Waters addressed instead of Agni.]

sections.label: A charm against the magic arts of fiends
sections.name: Hymn 24

verses.sa:
शेरभक शेरभ पुनर्वो यन्तु यातवः पुनर्हेतिः किमीदिनः ।
यस्य स्थ तमत्त यो वः प्राहैत् तमत्त स्वा मांसान्यत्त॥
verses.tr: śerabhaka śerabha punarvo yantu yātavaḥ punarhetiḥ kimīdinaḥ yasya stha tamatta yo vaḥ prāhait tamatta svā māṃsānyatta
verses.en: O Serabhaka, Serabha, back fall your arts of witchery! Back, Kimidins! let your weapon fall. Eat your possessor; eat ye him who sent you forth; eat your own flesh,

verses.sa:
शेवृधक शेवृध पुनर्वो यन्तु यातवः पुनर्हेतिः किमीदिनः ।
यस्य स्थ तमत्त यो वः प्राहैत् तमत्त स्वा मांसान्यत्त॥
verses.tr: śevṛdhaka śevṛdha punarvo yantu yātavaḥ punarhetiḥ kimīdinaḥ yasya stha tamatta yo vaḥ prāhait tamatta svā māṃsānyatta
verses.en: Sevridhaka, O Sevridha, back fall your arts of witchery! Back, Kimidins! let your weapon fall, etc,

verses.sa:
म्रोकानुम्रोक पुनर्वो यन्तु यातवः पुनर्हेतिः किमीदिनः ।
यस्य स्थ तमत्त यो वः प्राहैत् तमत्त स्वा मांसान्यत्त॥
verses.tr: mrokānumroka punarvo yantu yātavaḥ punarhetiḥ kimīdinaḥ yasya stha tamatta yo vaḥ prāhait tamatta svā māṃsānyatta
verses.en: O Mroka, Anumroka, back return your arts of witchery! Back, Kimidins! let your weapon fall, etc.

verses.sa:
सर्पानुसर्प पुनर्वो यन्तु यातवः पुनर्हेतिः किमीदिनः ।
यस्य स्थ तमत्त यो वः प्राहैत् तमत्त स्वा मांसान्यत्त॥
verses.tr: sarpānusarpa punarvo yantu yātavaḥ punarhetiḥ kimīdinaḥ yasya stha tamatta yo vaḥ prāhait tamatta svā māṃsānyatta
verses.en: O Sarpa, Anusarpa, back return your arts of witchery! Back, Kimidins! let your weapon fall, etc.

verses.sa:
जूर्णि पुनर्वो यन्तु यातवः पुनर्हेतिः किमीदिनीः ।
यस्य स्थ तमत्त यो वः प्राहैत् तमत्त स्वा मांसान्यत्त॥
verses.tr: jūrṇi punarvo yantu yātavaḥ punarhetiḥ kimīdinīḥ yasya stha tamatta yo vaḥ prāhait tamatta svā māṃsānyatta
verses.en: Back fall your witcheries, Jurpi! back your weapon, ye Kimidinis, etc.

verses.sa:
उपब्दे पुनर्वो यन्तु यातवः पुनर्हेतिः किमीदिनीः ।
यस्य स्थ तमत्त यो वः प्राहैत् तमत्त स्वा मांसान्यत्त॥
verses.tr: upabde punarvo yantu yātavaḥ punarhetiḥ kimīdinīḥ yasya stha tamatta yo vaḥ prāhait tamatta svā māṃsānyatta
verses.en: Back fall your spells, Upabdi!: back your weapon, ye Kimidins, etc.

verses.sa:
अर्जुनि पुनर्वो यन्तु यातवः पुनर्हेतिः किमीदिनीः ।
यस्य स्थ तमत्त यो वः प्राहैत् तमत्त स्वा मांसान्यत्त॥
verses.tr: arjuni punarvo yantu yātavaḥ punarhetiḥ kimīdinīḥ yasya stha tamatta yo vaḥ prāhait tamatta svā māṃsānyatta
verses.en: Back full your witchcraft, Arjuni! your weapon, ye Kimidins, etc.

verses.sa:
भरूजि पुनर्वो यन्तु यातवः पुनर्हेतिः किमीदिनीः ।
यस्य स्थ तमत्त यो वः प्राहैत् तमत्त स्वा मांसान्यत्त॥
verses.tr: bharūji punarvo yantu yātavaḥ punarhetiḥ kimīdinīḥ yasya stha tamatta yo vaḥ prāhait tamatta svā māṃsānyatta
verses.en: Back, O Bharati! fall your charms, your weapon, ye Kimidins, Eat your possessor; eat ye him who sent you forth; eat your own flesh.

sections.label: A charm against fiends who cause abortion
sections.name: Hymn 25

verses.sa:
शं नो देवी पृश्निपर्ण्यशं निरृत्या अकः ।
उग्रा हि कण्वजम्भनी तामभक्षि सहस्वतीम्॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no devī pṛśniparṇyaśaṃ nirṛtyā akaḥ ugrā hi kaṇvajambhanī tāmabhakṣi sahasvatīm
verses.en: The Goddess Prisniparni hath blest us, and troubled Nirriti. Fierce crusher of the Kanvas she: her have I gained, the mighty one.

verses.sa:
सहमानेयं प्रथमा पृश्निपर्ण्यऽजायत ।
तयाहं दुर्णाम्नां शिरो वृश्चामि शकुनेरिव॥
verses.tr: sahamāneyaṃ prathamā pṛśniparṇya'jāyata tayāhaṃ durṇāmnāṃ śiro vṛścāmi śakuneriva
verses.en: Victorious in the olden time this Prisniparni was brought forth: With her I cleave, as 'twere a bird's, the head of the Detestables.

verses.sa:
अरायमसृक्पावानं यश्च स्फातिं जिहीर्षति ।
गर्भादं कण्वं नाशय पृश्निपर्णि सहस्व च॥
verses.tr: arāyamasṛkpāvānaṃ yaśca sphātiṃ jihīrṣati garbhādaṃ kaṇvaṃ nāśaya pṛśniparṇi sahasva ca
verses.en: The hateful fiend who drinks the blood, and him who take away the growth, The Kanva who devours the germ, quell, Prisniparni! and destroy.

verses.sa:
गिरिमेनाँ आ वेशय कण्वान् जीवितयोपनान्।
तांस्त्वं देवि पृश्निपर्ण्यग्निरिवानुदहन्निहि॥
verses.tr: girimenāṃ ā veśaya kaṇvān jīvitayopanān tāṃstvaṃ devi pṛśniparṇyagnirivānudahannihi
verses.en: Drive and imprison in a hill these Kanvas harassers of life: Follow them Prisniparni, thou Goddess, like fire consuming them.

verses.sa:
पराच एनान् प्र णुद कण्वान् जीवितयोपनान्।
तमांसि यत्र गच्छन्ति तत् क्रव्यादो अजीगमम्॥
verses.tr: parāca enān pra ṇuda kaṇvān jīvitayopanān tamāṃsi yatra gacchanti tat kravyādo ajīgamam
verses.en: Drive thou away these Kanvas, drive the harassers of life afar. Whither the shades of darkness go, I send the fiend a who feed on flesh.

sections.label: A benediction on homeward coming cattle
sections.name: Hymn 26

verses.sa:
एह यन्तु पशवो ये परेयुर्वायुर्येषां सहचारं जुजोष ।
त्वष्टा येषां रूपधेयानि वेदास्मिन् तान् गोष्ठे सविता नि यछतु॥
verses.tr: eha yantu paśavo ye pareyurvāyuryeṣāṃ sahacāraṃ jujoṣa tvaṣṭā yeṣāṃ rūpadheyāni vedāsmin tān goṣṭhe savitā ni yachatu
verses.en: Let them come home, the cattle that have wandered, whom Vayu hath delighted to attend on. Whose forms and figures are well known to Tvashtar. These cows let Savitar drive within this stable.

verses.sa:
इमं गोष्ठं पशवः सं स्रवन्तु बृहस्पतिरा नयतु प्रजानन्।
सिनीवाली नयत्वाग्रमेषामाजग्मुषो अनुमते नि यछ॥
verses.tr: imaṃ goṣṭhaṃ paśavaḥ saṃ sravantu bṛhaspatirā nayatu prajānan sinīvālī nayatvāgrameṣāmājagmuṣo anumate ni yacha
verses.en: Let the beasts stream together to this cow-pen. Brihaspati who knoweth lead them hither! Let Sinivali guide the foremost homeward. When they have come, Anumati! enclose them.

verses.sa:
सं सं स्रवन्तु पशवः समश्वाः समु पूरुषाः ।
सं धान्यऽस्य या स्फातिः संस्राव्येऽण हविषा जुहोमि॥
verses.tr: saṃ saṃ sravantu paśavaḥ samaśvāḥ samu pūruṣāḥ saṃ dhānya'sya yā sphātiḥ saṃsrāvye'ṇa haviṣā juhomi
verses.en: Together stream the cattle! stream together horses and the men! J Hitherward press all growth of grain! I offer sacrifice with mixt oblation.

verses.sa:
सं सिञ्चामि गवां क्षीरं समाज्येन बलं रसम्।
संसिक्ता अस्माकं वीरा ध्रुवा गावो मयि गोपतौ॥
verses.tr: saṃ siñcāmi gavāṃ kṣīraṃ samājyena balaṃ rasam saṃsiktā asmākaṃ vīrā dhruvā gāvo mayi gopatau
verses.en: I pour together milk of kine, with butter blending strength and juice. Well sprinkled be our men, as true to me as cows are to their herd!

verses.sa:
आ हरामि गवां क्षीरमाहार्षं धान्यं१ रसम्।
आहृता अस्माकं वीरा आ पत्नीरिदमस्तकम्॥
verses.tr: ā harāmi gavāṃ kṣīramāhārṣaṃ dhānyaṃ1 rasam āhṛtā asmākaṃ vīrā ā patnīridamastakam
verses.en: Hither I bring the milk of cow? hither have brought the juice of corn. Hitherward have our men been brought, hitherward to this house our wives.

sections.label: A charm against an opponent in debate
sections.name: Hymn 27

verses.sa:
नेच्छत्रुः प्राशं जयाति सहमानाभिभूरसि ।
प्राशं प्रतिप्राशो जह्यरसान् कृन्वोषधे॥
verses.tr: necchatruḥ prāśaṃ jayāti sahamānābhibhūrasi prāśaṃ pratiprāśo jahyarasān kṛnvoṣadhe
verses.en: Let not the enemy win the cause! Strong and predominant art thou. Refute mine adversary's speech. Render them dull and flat, O Plant.

verses.sa:
सुपर्णस्त्वान्वविन्दत् सूकरस्त्वाखनन्नसा।
प्राशं प्रतिप्राशो जह्यरसान् कृण्वोषधे॥
verses.tr: suparṇastvānvavindat sūkarastvākhanannasā prāśaṃ pratiprāśo jahyarasān kṛṇvoṣadhe
verses.en: The strong-winged bird discovered thee, the boar unearthed thee with his snout. Refute mine adversary's speech. Render them dull and flat, O Plant.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो ह चक्रे त्वा बाहावसुरेभ्य स्तरीतवे ।
प्राशं प्रतिप्राशो जह्यरसान् कृण्वोषधे॥
verses.tr: indro ha cakre tvā bāhāvasurebhya starītave prāśaṃ pratiprāśo jahyarasān kṛṇvoṣadhe
verses.en: Yea, Indra laid thee on his arm, to cast the Asuras to the ground. Refute mine adversary's speech. Render them dull and flat, O Plant.

verses.sa:
पाटामिन्द्रो व्याऽश्नादसुरेभ्य स्तरीतवे ।
प्राशं प्रतिप्राशो जह्यरसान् कृण्वोषधे॥
verses.tr: pāṭāmindro vyā'śnādasurebhya starītave prāśaṃ pratiprāśo jahyarasān kṛṇvoṣadhe
verses.en: Indra devoured the Patha plant that he might lay the Asuras low. Refute mine adversary's speech. Render them dull and flat, O Plant.

verses.sa:
तयाहं शत्रून्त्साक्ष इन्द्रः सालावृकाँ इव ।
प्राशं प्रतिप्राशो जह्यरसान् कृण्वोषधे॥
verses.tr: tayāhaṃ śatrūntsākṣa indraḥ sālāvṛkāṃ iva prāśaṃ pratiprāśo jahyarasān kṛṇvoṣadhe
verses.en: With this I overcome my foes as Indra overcame the wolves. Refute mine adversary's speech! Render them dull and flat, O Plant.

verses.sa:
रुद्र जलाषभेषज नीलशिखण्ड कर्मकृत्।
प्राशं प्रतिप्राशो जह्यरसान् कृण्वोषधे॥
verses.tr: rudra jalāṣabheṣaja nīlaśikhaṇḍa karmakṛt prāśaṃ pratiprāśo jahyarasān kṛṇvoṣadhe
verses.en: O Rudra, Lord of Healing Balms, dark-created, skilful in thy work!—Refute mine adversary's speech. Render them dull and flat, O Plant.

verses.sa:
तस्य प्राशं त्वं जहि यो न इन्द्राभिदासति ।
अधि नो ब्रूहि शक्तिभिः प्राशि मामुत्तरं कृधि॥
verses.tr: tasya prāśaṃ tvaṃ jahi yo na indrābhidāsati adhi no brūhi śaktibhiḥ prāśi māmuttaraṃ kṛdhi
verses.en: Indra, defeat the speech of him who meets us with hostility. Comfort us with thy power and might. Make me superior in debate.

sections.label: A prayer for a boy's long and happy life
sections.name: Hymn 28

verses.sa:
तुभ्यमेव जरिमन् वर्धतामयं मेममन्ये मृत्यवो हिंसिषुः शतं ये।
मातेव पुत्रं प्रमना उपस्थे मित्र एनं मित्रियात् पात्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: tubhyameva jariman vardhatāmayaṃ memamanye mṛtyavo hiṃsiṣuḥ śataṃ ye māteva putraṃ pramanā upasthe mitra enaṃ mitriyāt pātvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: This Child, Old Age! shall grow to meet thee only: none of the hundred other deaths shall harm him. From trouble caused by friends let Mitra guard him, as a kind mother guards the son she nurses.

verses.sa:
मित्र एनं वरुणो वा रिशादा जरामृत्युं कृणुतां संविदानौ।
तदग्निर्होता वयुनानि विद्वान् विश्वा देवानां जनिमा विवक्ति॥
verses.tr: mitra enaṃ varuṇo vā riśādā jarāmṛtyuṃ kṛṇutāṃ saṃvidānau tadagnirhotā vayunāni vidvān viśvā devānāṃ janimā vivakti
verses.en: Mitra or Varuna the foe-destroyer, accordant, grant him death in course of nature! Thus Agni, Hotar-priest, skilled in high statutes, declareth all the deities' generations.

verses.sa:
त्वमीशिषे पशूनां पार्थिवानां ये जाता उत वा ये जनित्राः ।
मेमं प्राणो हासीन्मो अपानो मेमं मित्रा वधिषुर्मो अमित्राः॥
verses.tr: tvamīśiṣe paśūnāṃ pārthivānāṃ ye jātā uta vā ye janitrāḥ memaṃ prāṇo hāsīnmo apāno memaṃ mitrā vadhiṣurmo amitrāḥ
verses.en: Thou art the Lord of all terrestrial cattle, of cattle born and to be born hereafter. Let not breath drawn or breath emitted fail him. Let not his friends, let not his foemen slay him.

verses.sa:
द्यौष्ट्वा पिता पृथिवी माता जरामृत्युं कृणुतां संविदाने।
यथा जीवा अदितेरुपस्थे प्राणापानाभ्यां गुपितः शतं हिमाः॥
verses.tr: dyauṣṭvā pitā pṛthivī mātā jarāmṛtyuṃ kṛṇutāṃ saṃvidāne yathā jīvā aditerupasthe prāṇāpānābhyāṃ gupitaḥ śataṃ himāḥ
verses.en: Let Heaven thy father and let Earth thy mother, accordant, give thee death in course of nature, That thou mayst live on Aditi's bosom, guarded, a hundred winters, through thy respirations.

verses.sa:
इममग्ने आयुषे वर्चसे नय प्रियं रेतो वरुण मित्रराजन्।
मातेवास्मा अदिते शर्म यच्छ विश्वे देवा जरदष्टिर्यथासत्॥
verses.tr: imamagne āyuṣe varcase naya priyaṃ reto varuṇa mitrarājan mātevāsmā adite śarma yaccha viśve devā jaradaṣṭiryathāsat
verses.en: Lead him to life, O Agni, and to splendour, this dear child, Varuna! and thou King Mitra! Give him protection, Aditi! as a mother; All Gods, that his be life of long duration!

sections.label: A benediction on sick man
sections.name: Hymn 29

verses.sa:
पार्थिवस्य रसे देवा भगस्य तन्वो३ बले ।
आयुष्यऽमस्मा अग्निः सूर्यो वर्च आ धाद् बृहस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: pārthivasya rase devā bhagasya tanvo3 bale āyuṣya'masmā agniḥ sūryo varca ā dhād bṛhaspatiḥ
verses.en: Gods, give him all that earth hath best with bodily strength and happy fate. Agni and Surya grant him life, Brihaspati give him eminence!

verses.sa:
आयुरस्मै धेहि जातवेदः प्रजां त्वष्टरधिनिधेह्यस्मै।
रायस्पोषं सवितरा सुवास्मै शतं जीवाति शरदस्तवायम्॥
verses.tr: āyurasmai dhehi jātavedaḥ prajāṃ tvaṣṭaradhinidhehyasmai rāyaspoṣaṃ savitarā suvāsmai śataṃ jīvāti śaradastavāyam
verses.en: Bestow thou life on him, O Jatavedas. Store him with future progeny, O Tvashtar. Send him, O Savitar, full growth of riches. Let this thy servant live a hundred autumns.

verses.sa:
आशीर्ण ऊर्जमुत सौप्रजास्त्वं दक्षं धत्तं द्रविणं सचेतसौ ।
जयं क्षेत्राणि सहसायमिन्द्र कृण्वानो अन्यानधरान्त्सपत्नान्॥
verses.tr: āśīrṇa ūrjamuta sauprajāstvaṃ dakṣaṃ dhattaṃ draviṇaṃ sacetasau jayaṃ kṣetrāṇi sahasāyamindra kṛṇvāno anyānadharāntsapatnān
verses.en: May this our prayer bring strength and goodly offspring. Give, both of you one-minded, strength and riches. Let him with might win fields and victory, Indra! setting beneath his feet the rest, his rivals.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रेण दत्तो वरुणेन शिष्टो मरुद्भिरुग्रः प्रहितो न आगन्।
एष वां द्यावापृथिवी उपस्थे मा क्षुधन्मा तृषत्॥
verses.tr: indreṇa datto varuṇena śiṣṭo marudbhirugraḥ prahito na āgan eṣa vāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī upasthe mā kṣudhanmā tṛṣat
verses.en: As Indra's gift, by Varuna instructed the fierce one came to us sent by the Maruts. Let him, O Heaven and Earth, rest in your bosom. Let him not hunger, let him not be thirsty.

verses.sa:
ऊर्जमस्मा ऊर्जस्वती धत्तं पयो अस्मै पयस्वती धत्तम्।
ऊर्जमस्मै द्यावापृथिवी अधातां विश्वे देवा मरुत ऊर्जमापः॥
verses.tr: ūrjamasmā ūrjasvatī dhattaṃ payo asmai payasvatī dhattam ūrjamasmai dyāvāpṛthivī adhātāṃ viśve devā maruta ūrjamāpaḥ
verses.en: Ye twain endowed with vigour, grant him vigour. Ye who are rich in milk, give milk to feed him. These twain have given him vigour, Earth and Heaven, and all the Gods, the Maruts, and the Waters.

verses.sa:
शिवाभिष्टे हृदयं तर्पयाम्यनमीवो मोदिषीष्ठाः सुवर्चाः ।
सवासिनौ पिबतां मन्थमेतमश्विनो रूपं परिधाय मायाम्॥
verses.tr: śivābhiṣṭe hṛdayaṃ tarpayāmyanamīvo modiṣīṣṭhāḥ suvarcāḥ savāsinau pibatāṃ manthametamaśvino rūpaṃ paridhāya māyām
verses.en: With health-bestowing drops thine heart I comfort: all-bright again, and undiseased, enjoy them. Drest in like robes let these two drink the mixture, wearing the Asvins' form as an illusion.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र एतां ससृजे विद्धो अग्र ऊर्जां स्वधामजरां सा त एषा।
तया त्वं जीव शरदः सुवर्चा मा त आ सुस्रोद् भिषजस्ते अक्रन्॥
verses.tr: indra etāṃ sasṛje viddho agra ūrjāṃ svadhāmajarāṃ sā ta eṣā tayā tvaṃ jīva śaradaḥ suvarcā mā ta ā susrod bhiṣajaste akran
verses.en: Erst Indra, wounded, made this strengthening potion, eternal food: thine is it, here presented. With this live full of vigour through the autumns. Let not thy strength be drained. Leeches have helped thee.

sections.label: A man's toy charm
sections.name: Hymn 30

verses.sa:
यथेदं भूम्या अधि तृणं वातो मथायति ।
एवा मथ्नामि ते मनो यथा मां कामिन्यसो यथा मन्नापगा असः॥
verses.tr: yathedaṃ bhūmyā adhi tṛṇaṃ vāto mathāyati evā mathnāmi te mano yathā māṃ kāminyaso yathā mannāpagā asaḥ
verses.en: As the wind shakes this Tuft of Grass hither and thither on the ground, So do I stir and shake thy mind, that thou mayst be in love with me, my darling, never to depart.

verses.sa:
सं चेन्नयाथो अश्विना कामिना सं च वक्षथः ।
सं वां भगासो अग्मत सं चित्तानि समु व्रता॥
verses.tr: saṃ cennayātho aśvinā kāminā saṃ ca vakṣathaḥ saṃ vāṃ bhagāso agmata saṃ cittāni samu vratā
verses.en: Ye, Asvins, lead together, ye unite and bring the loving pair. Now have the fortunes of you twain, now have your vows and spirits met.

verses.sa:
यत् सुपर्णा विवक्षवो अनमीवा विवक्षवः ।
तत्र मे गछताद्धवं शल्य इव कुल्मलं यथा॥
verses.tr: yat suparṇā vivakṣavo anamīvā vivakṣavaḥ tatra me gachatāddhavaṃ śalya iva kulmalaṃ yathā
verses.en: When eagles, calling out aloud, are screaming in the joy of health, Then to my calling let her come, as to the arrow's neck the shaft.

verses.sa:
यदन्तरं तद् बाह्यं यद् बाह्यं तदन्तरम्।
कन्याऽनां विश्वरूपाणां मनो गृभायौषधे॥
verses.tr: yadantaraṃ tad bāhyaṃ yad bāhyaṃ tadantaram kanyā'nāṃ viśvarūpāṇāṃ mano gṛbhāyauṣadhe
verses.en: Let what is inward turn outside, let what is outward be within: Seize and possess, O Plant, the mind of maidens. rich in every charm.

verses.sa:
एयमगन् पतिकामा जनिकामोऽहमागमम्।
अश्वः कनिक्रदद् यथा भगेनाहं सहागमम्॥
verses.tr: eyamagan patikāmā janikāmo'hamāgamam aśvaḥ kanikradad yathā bhagenāhaṃ sahāgamam
verses.en: Seeking a husband she hath come! and I came longing for a wife: Even as a loudly-neighing steed my fate and fortune have I met.

sections.label: A charm against all sorts of Worms
sections.name: Hymn 31

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य या मही दृषत् क्रिमेर्विश्वस्य तर्हणी ।
तया पिनष्मि सं क्रिमीन् दृषदा खल्वाँ इव॥
verses.tr: indrasya yā mahī dṛṣat krimerviśvasya tarhaṇī tayā pinaṣmi saṃ krimīn dṛṣadā khalvāṃ iva
verses.en: With Indra's mighty millstone, that which crushes worms of every sort, I bray and bruise the worms to bits like vetches on the grinding stone.

verses.sa:
दृष्टमदृष्टमतृहमथो कुरूरुमतृहम्।
अल्गण्डून्त्सर्वान् छलुनान् क्रिमीन् वचसा जम्भयामसि॥
verses.tr: dṛṣṭamadṛṣṭamatṛhamatho kurūrumatṛham algaṇḍūntsarvān chalunān krimīn vacasā jambhayāmasi
verses.en: The Seen and the Invisible, and the Kururu have I crushed: Lands, and all Chhalunas, we bruise to pieces with our spell.

verses.sa:
अल्गण्डून् हन्मि महता वधेन दूना अदूना अरसा अभूवन्।
शिष्टानशिष्टान् नि तिरामि वाचा यथा क्रिमीणां नकिरुच्छिषातै॥
verses.tr: algaṇḍūn hanmi mahatā vadhena dūnā adūnā arasā abhūvan śiṣṭānaśiṣṭān ni tirāmi vācā yathā krimīṇāṃ nakirucchiṣātai
verses.en: I kill Lands with a mighty weapon: burnt or not burnt they now have lost their vigour. Left or not left, I with the spell subdue them: let not a single worm remain uninjured.

verses.sa:
अन्वान्त्र्यं शीर्षण्य१मथो पार्ष्टेयं क्रिमीन्।
अवस्कवं व्यध्वरं क्रिमीन् वचसा जम्भयामसि॥
verses.tr: anvāntryaṃ śīrṣaṇya1matho pārṣṭeyaṃ krimīn avaskavaṃ vyadhvaraṃ krimīn vacasā jambhayāmasi
verses.en: The worm "that lives within the ribs, within the bowels, in the head, Avaskava and Borer, these we bruise to pieces with the spell.

verses.sa:
ये क्रिमयः पर्वतेशु वनेष्वोषधीषु पशुष्वप्स्व१न्तः ।
ये अस्माकं तन्वऽमाविविशुः सर्वं तद्धन्मि जनिम क्रिमीणाम्॥
verses.tr: ye krimayaḥ parvateśu vaneṣvoṣadhīṣu paśuṣvapsva1ntaḥ ye asmākaṃ tanva'māviviśuḥ sarvaṃ taddhanmi janima krimīṇām
verses.en: Worms that are found on mountains, in the forests, that live in plants, in cattle, in the waters, Those that have made their way within our bodies,—these I destroy, the worms' whole generation.

sections.label: A charm against worms or bots in cows
sections.name: Hymn 32

verses.sa:
उद्यन्नादित्यः क्रिमीन् हन्तु निम्रोचन् हन्तु रश्मिभिः ।
ये अन्तः क्रिमयो गवि॥
verses.tr: udyannādityaḥ krimīn hantu nimrocan hantu raśmibhiḥ ye antaḥ krimayo gavi
verses.en: Uprising let the Sun destroy, and when he sinketh, with his beams The Worms that live within the cow.

verses.sa:
विश्वरूपं चतुरक्षं क्रिमिं सारङ्गमर्जुनम्।
शृणाम्यस्य पृष्टीरपि वृश्चामि यच्छिरः॥
verses.tr: viśvarūpaṃ caturakṣaṃ krimiṃ sāraṅgamarjunam śṛṇāmyasya pṛṣṭīrapi vṛścāmi yacchiraḥ
verses.en: The four-eyed worm, of every shape, the variegated, and the white I break and crush the creature's ribs, and tear away its head besides.

verses.sa:
अत्रिवद् वः क्रिमयो हन्मि कण्ववज्जमदग्निवत्।
अगस्त्यस्य ब्रह्मणा सं पिनष्म्यहं क्रिमीन्॥
verses.tr: atrivad vaḥ krimayo hanmi kaṇvavajjamadagnivat agastyasya brahmaṇā saṃ pinaṣmyahaṃ krimīn
verses.en: Like Atri I destroy you, Worms! in Kanva's, Jamadagni's way: I bray and bruise the creeping things to pieces with Agastya's spell.

verses.sa:
हतो राजा क्रिमीणामुतैषां स्थपतिर्हतः ।
हतो हतमाता क्रिमिर्हतभ्राता हतस्वसा॥
verses.tr: hato rājā krimīṇāmutaiṣāṃ sthapatirhataḥ hato hatamātā krimirhatabhrātā hatasvasā
verses.en: Slain is the sovran of these Worms, ye, their controlling lord is slain: Slain is the Worm, his mother slain, brother and sister both are slain.

verses.sa:
हतासो अस्य वेशसो हतासः परिवेशसः ।
अथो ये क्षुल्लका इव सर्वे ते क्रिमयो हताः॥
verses.tr: hatāso asya veśaso hatāsaḥ pariveśasaḥ atho ye kṣullakā iva sarve te krimayo hatāḥ
verses.en: Slain are his ministers, and slain his followers and retinue: Yea, those that seemed the tiniest things, the Worms have all been put to death.

verses.sa:
प्र ते शृणामि शृङ्गे याभ्यां वितुदायसि ।
भिनाद्मि ते कुषुम्भं यस्ते विषधानः॥
verses.tr: pra te śṛṇāmi śṛṅge yābhyāṃ vitudāyasi bhinādmi te kuṣumbhaṃ yaste viṣadhānaḥ
verses.en: I break in pieces both thy horns wherewith thou pushest here and there: I cleave and rend the bag which holds the venom which is stored in thee.

sections.label: A charm against Consumption (yaksha)
sections.name: Hymn 33

verses.sa:
अक्षीभ्यां ते नासिकाभ्यां कर्णाभ्यां छुबुकादधि ।
यक्ष्मं शीर्षण्यं ऽ मस्तिष्काज्जिह्वाया वि वृहामि ते॥
verses.tr: akṣībhyāṃ te nāsikābhyāṃ karṇābhyāṃ chubukādadhi yakṣmaṃ śīrṣaṇyaṃ ' mastiṣkājjihvāyā vi vṛhāmi te
verses.en: From both thy nostrils, from both eyes, from both thine ears, and from thy chin, Forth from thy brain and tongue I root Consumption seated in thy head.

verses.sa:
ग्रीवाभ्यस्त उष्णिहाभ्यः कीकसाभ्यो अनूक्याऽत्।
यक्ष्मं दोषण्य१मंसाभ्यां बाहुभ्यां वि वृहामि ते॥
verses.tr: grīvābhyasta uṣṇihābhyaḥ kīkasābhyo anūkyā't yakṣmaṃ doṣaṇya1maṃsābhyāṃ bāhubhyāṃ vi vṛhāmi te
verses.en: Forth from the neck and from the nape, from dorsal vertebrae and spine, From arms and shoulder-blades I root Consumption. seated in thine arms.

verses.sa:
हृदयात् ते परि क्लोम्नो हलीक्ष्णात् पार्श्वाभ्याम्।
यक्ष्मं मतस्नाभ्यां प्लीह्नो यक्नस्ते वि वृहामसि॥
verses.tr: hṛdayāt te pari klomno halīkṣṇāt pārśvābhyām yakṣmaṃ matasnābhyāṃ plīhno yaknaste vi vṛhāmasi
verses.en: Forth from thy heart and from thy lungs, from thy gall-bladder and thy side? From kidneys, spleen, and liver thy Consumption we eradicate.

verses.sa:
आन्त्रेभ्यस्ते गुदाभ्यो वनिष्ठोरुदरादधि ।
यक्ष्मं कुक्षिभ्यां प्लाशेर्नाभ्या वि वृहामि ते॥
verses.tr: āntrebhyaste gudābhyo vaniṣṭhorudarādadhi yakṣmaṃ kukṣibhyāṃ plāśernābhyā vi vṛhāmi te
verses.en: From bowels and intestines, from the rectum and the belly, I Extirpate thy Consumption, from flanks, navel, and mesentery.

verses.sa:
ऊरुभ्यां ते अष्ठीवद्भ्यां पार्ष्णिभ्यां प्रपदाभ्याम्।
यक्ष्मं भसद्यं१ श्रोणिभ्यां भासदं भंससो वि वृहामि ते॥
verses.tr: ūrubhyāṃ te aṣṭhīvadbhyāṃ pārṣṇibhyāṃ prapadābhyām yakṣmaṃ bhasadyaṃ1 śroṇibhyāṃ bhāsadaṃ bhaṃsaso vi vṛhāmi te
verses.en: Forth from thy thighs and from thy knees, heels and the foreparts of thy feet, Forth from thy loins and hips I draw Consumption settled in thy loins.

verses.sa:
अस्थिभ्यस्ते मज्जभ्यः स्नावभ्यो धमनिभ्यः ।
यक्ष्मं पाणिभ्यामङ्गुलिभ्यो नखेभ्यो वि वृहामि ते॥
verses.tr: asthibhyaste majjabhyaḥ snāvabhyo dhamanibhyaḥ yakṣmaṃ pāṇibhyāmaṅgulibhyo nakhebhyo vi vṛhāmi te
verses.en: Forth from thy marrows and thy bones, forth from thy tendons and thy veins I banish thy Consumption, from thy hand? thy fingers, and thy nails.

verses.sa:
अङ्गेअङ्गे लोम्निलोम्नि यस्ते पर्वणिपर्वणि ।
यक्ष्मं त्वचस्य ऽ ते वयं कश्यपस्य वीबर्हेण विष्वञ्चं वि वृहामसि॥
verses.tr: aṅgeaṅge lomnilomni yaste parvaṇiparvaṇi yakṣmaṃ tvacasya ' te vayaṃ kaśyapasya vībarheṇa viṣvañcaṃ vi vṛhāmasi
verses.en: In every member, every hair, in every joint wherein it lie? We with the exorcising spell of Kasyapa drive far away Consumption settled in thy skin.

sections.label: A prayer accompanying an animal sacrifice
sections.name: Hymn 34

verses.sa:
य ईशे पशुपतिः पशूनां चतुष्पदामुत यो द्विपदाम्।
निष्क्रीतः स यज्ञियं भागमेतु रायस्पोषा यजमानं सचन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: ya īśe paśupatiḥ paśūnāṃ catuṣpadāmuta yo dvipadām niṣkrītaḥ sa yajñiyaṃ bhāgametu rāyaspoṣā yajamānaṃ sacantām
verses.en: May this, of all the beasts that Pasupati rules, Lord of animals, quadruped and biped, Come, purchased, to the sacrificial portion. May growth of wealth attend the sacrificer.

verses.sa:
प्रमुञ्चन्तो भुवनस्य रेतो गातुं धत्त यजमानाय देवाः ।
उपाकृतं शशमानं यदस्थात् प्रियं देवानामप्येतु पाथः॥
verses.tr: pramuñcanto bhuvanasya reto gātuṃ dhatta yajamānāya devāḥ upākṛtaṃ śaśamānaṃ yadasthāt priyaṃ devānāmapyetu pāthaḥ
verses.en: Loosing the seed of future-time existence, give good success, O Gods, to him who worships. May what is present, duly brought, the victim, goto the deities' beloved region.

verses.sa:
ये बध्यमानमनु दीध्याना अन्वैक्षन्त मनसा चक्षुषा च ।
अग्निष्टानग्रे प्र मुमोक्तु देवो विश्वकर्मा प्रजया संरराणः॥
verses.tr: ye badhyamānamanu dīdhyānā anvaikṣanta manasā cakṣuṣā ca agniṣṭānagre pra mumoktu devo viśvakarmā prajayā saṃrarāṇaḥ
verses.en: Those who are looking, deep in meditation, on the bound animal with eye and spirit—To them, the first, may Agni, God, give freedom, rejoicing in his creatures, Visvakarman.

verses.sa:
ये ग्राम्याः पशवो विश्वरूपा विरूपाः सन्तो बहुधैकरूपाः ।
वायुष्टानग्रे प्र मुमोक्तु देवः प्रजापतिः प्रजया संरराणः॥
verses.tr: ye grāmyāḥ paśavo viśvarūpā virūpāḥ santo bahudhaikarūpāḥ vāyuṣṭānagre pra mumoktu devaḥ prajāpatiḥ prajayā saṃrarāṇaḥ
verses.en: Tame animals of every shape, though varied in colour, manifold, alike in nature—To them, the first, may Vayu, God, give freedom, Prajapati rejoicing in his creatures.

verses.sa:
प्रजानन्तः प्रति गृह्णन्तु पूर्वे प्राणमङ्गेभ्यः पर्याचरन्तम्।
दिवं गच्छ प्रति तिष्ठा शरीरैः स्वर्गं याहि पथिभिर्देवयानैः॥
verses.tr: prajānantaḥ prati gṛhṇantu pūrve prāṇamaṅgebhyaḥ paryācarantam divaṃ gaccha prati tiṣṭhā śarīraiḥ svargaṃ yāhi pathibhirdevayānaiḥ
verses.en: Let those who know receive before all others the vital breath proceeding from the body. Go to the sky. Stay there with all thy members. By paths which Gods have travelled go to Svarga.

sections.label: Expiration for an imperfectly performed sacrifice
sections.name: Hymn 35

verses.sa:
ये भक्षयन्तो न वसून्यानृधुर्यानग्नयो अन्वतप्यन्त धिष्ण्याः ।
या तेषामवया दुरिष्टिः स्विऽष्टिं नस्तां कृणवद् विश्वकर्मा॥
verses.tr: ye bhakṣayanto na vasūnyānṛdhuryānagnayo anvatapyanta dhiṣṇyāḥ yā teṣāmavayā duriṣṭiḥ svi'ṣṭiṃ nastāṃ kṛṇavad viśvakarmā
verses.en: We who enjoying it have grown no richer, for whom the sacred altar-fires have sorrowed, We who compounded with deficient worship, may Visvakarman make our service prosper. is

verses.sa:
यज्ञपतिमृषयः एनसाहुर्निर्भक्तं प्रजा अनुतप्यमानम्।
मथव्याऽन्त्स्तोकानप यान् रराध सं नष्टेभिः सृजतु विश्वकर्मा॥
verses.tr: yajñapatimṛṣayaḥ enasāhurnirbhaktaṃ prajā anutapyamānam mathavyā'ntstokānapa yān rarādha saṃ naṣṭebhiḥ sṛjatu viśvakarmā
verses.en: have called the sacrifices patron amerced through sin, sorrowing for his offspring. Those drops of meath whereof he missed enjoyment,—may Visvakarman! with those drops unite us.

verses.sa:
अदान्यान्त्सोमपान् मन्यमानो यज्ञस्य विद्वान्त्समये न धीरः ।
यदेनश्चकृवान् बद्ध एष तं विश्वकर्मन् प्र मुञ्चा स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: adānyāntsomapān manyamāno yajñasya vidvāntsamaye na dhīraḥ yadenaścakṛvān baddha eṣa taṃ viśvakarman pra muñcā svastaye
verses.en: Regarding niggard churls as Soma-drinkers, skilful in sacrifice, weak at the meeting, Whatever sin the captive hath committed, do thou for weal release him, Visvakarman!

verses.sa:
घोरा ऋषयो नमो अस्त्वेभ्यश्चक्षुर्यदेषां मनसश्च सत्यम्।
बृहस्पतये महिष द्युमन्नमो विश्वकर्मन् नमस्ते पाह्य१स्मान्॥
verses.tr: ghorā ṛṣayo namo astvebhyaścakṣuryadeṣāṃ manasaśca satyam bṛhaspataye mahiṣa dyumannamo viśvakarman namaste pāhya1smān
verses.en: Awful are Rishis: unto them be homage, and to their eye and truthfulness of spirit! Loud homage to Brihaspati, O mighty! Homage to thee, O Visvakarman! t Guard us.

verses.sa:
यज्ञस्य चक्षुः प्रभृतिर्मुखं च वाचा श्रोत्रेण मनसा जुहोमि ।
इमं यज्ञं विततं विश्वकर्मणा देवा यन्तु सुमनस्यमानाः॥
verses.tr: yajñasya cakṣuḥ prabhṛtirmukhaṃ ca vācā śrotreṇa manasā juhomi imaṃ yajñaṃ vitataṃ viśvakarmaṇā devā yantu sumanasyamānāḥ
verses.en: The eye of sacrifice, source, and beginning—with voice, ear, spirit unto him I offer. To this our sacrifice wrought by Visvakarman may the Gods come gracious and kindly-hearted.

sections.label: A charm to secure a husband for a marriageable girl
sections.name: Hymn 36

verses.sa:
आ नो अग्ने सुमतिं संभलो गमेदिमां कुमारीं सह नो भगेन ।
जुष्टा वरेषु समनेषु वल्गुरोषं पत्या सौभगमस्त्वस्यै॥
verses.tr: ā no agne sumatiṃ saṃbhalo gamedimāṃ kumārīṃ saha no bhagena juṣṭā vareṣu samaneṣu valguroṣaṃ patyā saubhagamastvasyai
verses.en: To please us may the suitor come, O Agni, seeking this maid and bringing us good fortune. Approved by wooers, lovely in assemblies, may she be soon made happy with a husband.

verses.sa:
सोमजुष्टं ब्रह्मजुष्टमर्यम्णा संभृतं भगम्।
धातुर्देवस्य सत्येन कृणोमि पतिवेदनम्॥
verses.tr: somajuṣṭaṃ brahmajuṣṭamaryamṇā saṃbhṛtaṃ bhagam dhāturdevasya satyena kṛṇomi pativedanam
verses.en: As bliss beloved by Soma, dear to Prayer, and stored by Aryaman, With the God Dhatar's truthfulness I work the bridal oracle.

verses.sa:
इयमग्ने नारी पतिं विदेष्ट सोमो हि राजा सुभगां कृणोति ।
सुवाना पुत्रान् महिषी भवाति गत्वा पतिं सुभगा वि राजतु॥
verses.tr: iyamagne nārī patiṃ videṣṭa somo hi rājā subhagāṃ kṛṇoti suvānā putrān mahiṣī bhavāti gatvā patiṃ subhagā vi rājatu
verses.en: O Agni, may this woman find a husband. Then verily King Soma makes her happy. May she bear sons, chief lady of the household, blessed and bearing rule beside her consort.

verses.sa:
यथाखरो मघवंश्चारुरेष प्रियो मृगाणां सुषदा बभूव ।
एवा भगस्य जुष्टेयमस्तु नारी संप्रिया पत्याविराधयन्ती॥
verses.tr: yathākharo maghavaṃścārureṣa priyo mṛgāṇāṃ suṣadā babhūva evā bhagasya juṣṭeyamastu nārī saṃpriyā patyāvirādhayantī
verses.en: As this lair, Maghavan! that is fair to look on was dear to wild things as a pleasant dwelling, So may this woman here be Bhaga's darling, loved by her lord and prizing his affection.

verses.sa:
भगस्य नावमा रोह पूर्णामनुपदस्वतीम्।
तयोपप्रतारय यो वरः प्रतिकाम्यः॥
verses.tr: bhagasya nāvamā roha pūrṇāmanupadasvatīm tayopapratāraya yo varaḥ pratikāmyaḥ
verses.en: Mount up, embark on Bhaga's ship, the full, the inexhaustible, Thereon bring hitherward to us the lover whom thou fain wouldst wed.

verses.sa:
आ क्रन्दय धनपते वरमामनसं कृणु ।
सर्वं प्रदक्षिणं कृणु यो वरः प्रतिकाम्यः॥
verses.tr: ā krandaya dhanapate varamāmanasaṃ kṛṇu sarvaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛṇu yo varaḥ pratikāmyaḥ
verses.en: Call out to him, O Lord of Wealth! Make thou the lover well-inclined. Set each on thy right hand who is a lover worthy of her choice.

verses.sa:
इदं हिरण्यं गुल्गुल्वयमौक्षो अथो भगः ।
एते पतिभ्यस्त्वामदुः प्रतिकामाय वेत्तवे॥
verses.tr: idaṃ hiraṇyaṃ gulgulvayamaukṣo atho bhagaḥ ete patibhyastvāmaduḥ pratikāmāya vettave
verses.en: Here is the Bdellium and the gold, the Auksha and the bliss are here: These bring thee to the husbands, so to find the man whom thou woudst have.

verses.sa:
आ ते नयतु सविता नयतु पतिर्यः प्रतिकाम्यः ।
त्वमस्यै धेह्योषधे॥
verses.tr: ā te nayatu savitā nayatu patiryaḥ pratikāmyaḥ tvamasyai dhehyoṣadhe
verses.en: May Savitar lead and bring to thee the husband whom thy heart desires. O Plant, be this thy gift to her!
